notes.title: Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2 update fixes friendly fire and nerfs sniper cloak
notes.content:
A new Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2 update today has a blend of good and bad news for players. Saber Interactive's Patch 10 recently beefed up its high-octane, Tyranid-trouncing and Chaos-carving experience with new PvE and PvP modes, and it's been watching the balance carefully since. Now, it's made the call to tackle sniper cloak abuse a little earlier than planned, rushing out an adjustment that was originally on the cards for Patch 11. Among the other changes are a much-needed fix for bugs causing accidental friendly fire damage, which should make your matches less hostile.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Patch Notes 10.2
notes.content:
​Hello Space Marines,

[p align="start"]A new hotfix is now live on every platform. It fixes critical issues such as the Assault’s Ascension perk dealing friendly-fire damage, Stratagems having more Battlefield Conditions than listed and more. Also, the Sniper’s Camo Cloak activation cost change (which was initially planned for 11.0) has also been pushed on this update. Read the complete patch notes below:
[p align="start"]
PATCH NOTES

GAMEPLAY AND BALANCING TWEAKS[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Heroic Chainsword:

Rebalanced base stats.

Reworked its perk: Light->Heavy->Heavy combo now ends with a Stomp attack.

All Heavy attacks damage increased by 15%.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Stratagems:

Fixed an issue where Daily Stratagems could have more Battlefield Conditions than listed.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Camo Cloak's activation cost:
[p align="start"]The activation cost of the Sniper ability has been changed. Now it works this way: 

The first three uses of Camo Cloak in a row do not take away energy by themselves (the ability consumes energy, as before). The fourth activation takes away 5% of energy instantly, each subsequent one takes away a little more. After the last use, there is a 10-second timer, after which the activation cost again becomes zero.

With the right perk set up, you can still do 5-6 cloak cancels in a row. Cloak cancel will still be very rewarding to learn and to do, but you won't be able to abuse it endlessly while staying invisible and invulnerable to enemies.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Spawn Director:

The number of Chaos Spawns in packs is slightly reduced and now matches Tyranid Warriors.
[p align="start"]
GENERAL FIXES[p align="start"]

Fixed damage for the Power Backstep attack when the Power Wave perk is selected for Power Axe.

Improved flame weapons VFX visibility for allies.

Fixed an issue that prevented bots from entering elevators in Exfiltration operation.

Fixed perks dealing friendly fire damage.

Fixed PvP connectivity issues.

Minor localization fixes.

Minor UI fixes.

ESRB update pop-up: A pop-up will appear on the main menu to inform you of an update of the ESRB rating. This pop-up will only appear once. 

Please note that this update of our rating is just here to properly reflect what was already in-game for several months. There has been no change to our monetization system, and no changes are planned.

notes.title: Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2 finally releases fan favorite helmets in new patch
notes.content:
Warhammer fans are a funny bunch, and I count myself among them. In fact, I might be one of the funniest of them all. I stan a niche Chapter whose only real trait is lamenting the loss of their Primarch-so niche, in fact, that two second founding Chapters will be released in Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2 before the Iron Hands-and love creating twisted monstrosities in the name of the Omnissiah. However, I don't care too much about bling. Other fans have been disappointed that Space Marine 2 doesn't offer any undecorated helmets for older marks of power armor for some reason, but developer Saber Interactive has finally answered their prayers.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Patch Notes 10.1
notes.content:
​Hello Space Marines[p align="start"]A hotfix has just been pushed on every platform. Following your feedback, we increased the amount of Accolades rewarded for daily Stratagems. Also, the bug causing the Trygon to disappear in this week’s stratagem has been fixed, among other fixes.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Read the complete patch notes below:


PATCH NOTES

GAMEPLAY AND BALANCING TWEAKS

Melee (PvE only)[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Power Axe:

Slash Momentum and Discharge perks places are switched.

Whirlwind attacks are widened and damage is increased by 50%.

Power Step attack damage is increased by 66%.

Slash Momentum perk description is showing correct numbers now.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Combat Knife:

Heroic Combat Knife version “Power Gladius” bonus damage for perfect dodge increased to 120%.
[p align="start"]Note that description is still incorrect, the bonus damage affects all attacks, not light attacks only.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Bulwark:

Shield Rush attack can no longer stun lock Terminus enemies.
[p align="start"]
Stratagems[p align="start"]

Increased rewards for daily Normal and Hard Stratagems to 10 and 15 respectively.

Suboptimal State Battlefield Condition HP penalty is reduced from 75% to 66%.
[p align="start"]
PvP[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Multi-Melta:

The interval between shots is now enforced when transitioning to the standing position. 

Additionally, the rate of fire from hip fire has been increased from 35 to 50 rounds-per-minute.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
CUSTOMISATION
Lots of minor customisation fixes.

Mark VIII Errant Helmet without decorations is now available for purchase. (Mark VII without decorations will be available later as well).

Ultramarines Champion Armour Parts are now correctly locked by the Ultramarines Champion Pack DLC.
[p align="start"]
LEVELS[p align="start"]

Operation Vortex: Armoury Data is correctly rewarded for killing the Vortex Beast.


GENERAL FIXES


Fixed a bug causing the Trygon Prime to leave the boss arena to attack Cadians in Stratagem mode.

Fixed a bug with the Emperor's Vengeance perk (Tactical) not restoring Melta Charges for Heroic Bolt Rifle version (Combi-Melta).

Fixed: Stratagems didn't work when offline.

Fixed a rare issue in Helbrute Onslaught game mode causing a black screen after selecting a class. 

Minor localization fixes.

Lots of minor bug fixes.


TECH


Crash fixes and general stability improvements.


KNOWN ISSUES


More than 4 Battlefield Conditions can currently be active in a single Stratagem mission, but the selection menu will only show 4 of them. Will be fixed and limited to 4 in an upcoming hotfix.

On "Exfiltration", Bots are not following the player through the elevator to enter the base. This can be caused when enemies are still in the area. Completely clearing the area and rushing to the elevator before the next wave spawns should prevent this issue.

notes.title: Space Marine 2 Patch 10 is packed with new weapons, modes, and threats
notes.content:
It is hard to believe it's already been a year since Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2 came out. The third-person shooter launched to fan acclaim and has gotten a steady run of updates ever since. To celebrate its first anniversary, Space Marine 2 is getting a host of new features as part of Patch 10, including a fierce PvP mode, a strategic PvE mode, a new operation, and even more weapons. The best part? It's totally free.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The 10.0 - Anniversary Update is OUT
notes.content:
Hi Space Marines! [p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Today’s Anniversary Update brings two new game modes, new maps for the Operations and Eternal War modes, weapons, enemies and more! The kick-off of Year 2 also marks the release of the game’s Season Pass II, promising new Chapter-inspired cosmetics.
[p align="start"]
Check out our Anniversary Update Trailer!

[previewyoutube="HKYdoezikPM;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"]
A Battle-Barge-sized shipment of Free Content 🆓

[p align="start"]Space Marine 2 celebrates the one-year anniversary of its release with more free content than ever in a single update, covering every possible aspect of the game. New game modes, new missions, maps, enemies, weapons, and more quality-of-life improvements than there are Xenos in the universe. 
[p align="start"]Check out the details below, and make sure to read our Anniversary Update patch notes for more information.

The Anniversary Update brings: 

the new “Vortex” Operation, featuring a fearsome new boss, the Mutalith Vortex Beast

a new PvP arena, “Bridge”, set on Avarax

a new PvE game mode called “Stratagems”, introducing daily and weekly gameplay modifiers

a new “Helbrute Onslaught” game mode for PvP, with a playable Helbrute!

3 new weapons - Pyreblaster, Pyrecannon & Power Axe - and several new weapon variants, like the Xenophase Blade, Combi Melta or double-edged Chainsword

a new Majoris enemy: the Chaos Spawn, coming in three unique variants

a set of six unique Chaos Champion skins, unlockable in Eternal War mode

tons of quality-of-life and customisation improvements, like the ability to use Champion skins as multiple, individual cosmetics with any of the game’s playable classes.
[p align="start"]
The Black Templars and Imperial Fists get new DLCs ⚫Sons of Rogal Dorn rejoice![p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Today’s Update also comes with the release of the second Season Pass and its first two DLCs: the Black Templars Champion Pack and Imperial Fists Cosmetic Pack. The former includes a new Champion skin for the Bulwark class and Power Sword skin, while the latter adds over 40 new cosmetics and heraldry markings celebrating 7 of the Imperial Fists’ Successor Chapters.
[p align="start"]​

notes.title: Patch Notes 10.0 - Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Greetings Space Marines,[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Here's you can find the changelog for the 10.0 Update of Space Marine 2.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/3b03741092fadd64b499c859b2603b18cc9558d8.jpg"]
[p align="start"]Hope you'll enjoy the changes, let us know your thoughts.
[p align="start"]

NEW FEATURES 

[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/b980b551d7f742c37a2d5733cdafe442ef725a38.png"]
NEW OPERATION: VORTEX[p align="start"]

In Vortex, you'll return to the Astropathic Relay on Avarax, which has once again fallen silent. Your task is to investigate and cleanse the Relay of lingering heretical presence, and confront a mighty enemy lurking in its deepest levels.
[p align="start"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/4b9c4e1341dfc0208f60c6c1d2334f4f88d484b4.png"]
NEW ENEMIES[p align="start"]

Mutalith Vortex Beast

Mutalith Vortex Beast is a new boss in Operation Vortex. It is a towering, warp-twisted monstrosity that drags reality into spiraling chaos. It rends and crashes with its claws and unleashes storms of sorcerous energy upon the Astartes.

Chaos Spawn variations

Chaos Spawns are new Majoris enemies that can appear in all Operations featuring the Thousand Sons.



Chaos Spawns are dark abominations, powerful melee units infused with forbidden sorcery. They are fearsome opponents, especially when encountered in greater numbers. Their varied mutated limbs grant them a highly diverse and lethal moveset. However, it is an Astartes’ duty to study them and purge the heresy.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/5177df74891f1bafa0829473acb9122c3ffbd2c1.jpg"]
[/td][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/832a7a5fb3bf4447344b9851ef26f8edb08d7c0f.jpg"]
[/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/37f752d2cb961d5ad2b141c7b422ee09dccddd43.png"]
NEW WEAPONS[p align="start"]

Power Axe (for PvE and PvP)

The Power Axe is a swift, aggressive power weapon capable of delivering relentless, infinitely chaining attacks. Wielded by the Vanguard, Assault and Bulwark classes, it allows a Space Marine to unleash a hail of blows upon their foes.



This is a fierce yet tactical weapon. Successfully executed perfect parry puts the Marine in a Power Stance, creating a moment of tactical choice: step back and release a devastating Power Wave or press forward to continue the fearsome combo.

Pyreblaster and Pyrecannon (for PvE)

In this update, we are introducing a new weapon: the Pyreblaster & Pyrecannon, for the Tactical and Heavy classes.



The flamer weapons now apply a burning effect on enemies, which inflicts significant damage over time (which scales based on difficulty). In addition to that, flames also slow down Minoris enemies.



An effective strategy would be to try to set as many enemies on fire and keep them burning.
[p align="start"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/925561337fcb9f6f59e7469e7dda806a10435219.png"]
NEW PVE MODE "STRATAGEMS"[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Battlefield Conditions change weekly and daily, completing a Stratagem grants a new currency called “Accolades”. 
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Reworked Data Refinement Shop on Battle Barge:
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]The “Data Refinement” shop has been renamed and now offers a variety of additional items. Now, it will also redeem old Community Giveaways and Accolades items.
[p align="start"]You can spend Accolades in the "Refinement & Redemption" shop to unlock unique items.
[p align="start"]

Added 6 Heroic Weapons to unlock with Accolades

Added 6 Heroic Armour Pieces 
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/e96f080f47102444bf71cb8cbc1c107a9a42b350.jpg"]
[/td][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/0b0b4e4fb071e2fa73085c2ba01073d5faa6f636.png"]
[/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/742db4884527d59636b97a8bb352f9ebee0681a6.png"]
NEW PVP MODE: HELBRUTE ONSLAUGHT


Two teams of Chaos Marines will fight to control strategic areas, but also to take control of the Helbrute. The first team to take control of an objective gets to control the Helbrute, until the opposite team takes it down. One player gets to control the Helbrute at a time, and this player will be picked randomly among players who participated in securing the control point. For the team that failed to secure the first control point to have the Helbrute on their side, they will need to slay their opponents’ Helbrute and secure a new designated control point.



Controlling the Helbrute grants the team a strong advantage, but killing it rewards significant amounts of points to your team. One last thing, the Helbrute uses a Helbrute Thunder Hammer in melee, and a Plasma Cannon in range, and it can unleash a battle cry with its special skill to regenerate its HP.


NEW PVP MAP: BRIDGE [p align="start"]​[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/d522b245c5629c0178e0d3f52cbe0d96016417f9.jpg"]
ADDED 6 CHAOS RELIC ARMOUR SETS FOR PVP[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/7595eb504e4c6300b8409ba31cb8f86dd44c84b0.png"]


[p align="start"]​These Armour Sets are now available to unlock by playing and scoring kills in Eternal War mode. For each skin, you will have to get 9 kills in more than 9 Eternal War matches to unlock the skin of the class you’re playing. 


NEW ORDEALS ADDED FOR PVP

ADDED NEW FINISHERS[p align="start"]

Full set for Power Axe.

Full set for all melee weapons against Chaos Spawn.

1 new finisher against Biovore


ADDED CHAMPION ARMOUR PIECES FOR CUSTOMISATION (ALL CLASSES)[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]This long awaited feature is now available! You can now mix various parts of the Champion’s Armours on different classes. 
[p align="start"]Please note that not every armour part will be available for mixing in every class.

NEW SEASON PASS CONTENT:[p align="start"]

Black Templars Champion Pack added.

Imperial Fists Cosmetic Pack added.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/961eeae14a28a0950088f8cb200796c384d4e06d.jpg"]
[/td][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/990c6fba654d00848899cf3a10c6d824abe63e6e.png"]
[/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]

GAMEPLAY & BALANCING TWEAKS

[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/53c65cd68eec73dd6fe9780c8b6ba43b39b37279.png"]

FIREARMS

[p align="start"]Bolt Pistol:
[p align="start"]Headshot damage coefficient increased from 1.15 to 1.25 for all versions.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Master-Crafted Bolt Pistol Alpha

Spread reduction increased from 15% to 30%.

Recoil reduction increased from 20% to 40%.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Salvation of Bakka Artificer Bolt Pistol

Spread reduction increased from 30% to 45%.

Recoil reduction increased from 40% to 60%.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Gathalamor Crusade Relic Bolt Pistol

Spread reduction increased from 55% to 70%.

Recoil reduction increased from 60% to 80%.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]Auto Bolt Rifle:

Base damage increased by 25%.

Added damage falloff curve from distance. After 20 meters, weapon damage falls by 25%.

Headshot damage coefficient increased from 1.15 to 1.25 for all versions.

The Auto Bolt rifle suffers from that "default" gun syndrome that you swap to something more interesting immediately. The problem is that other guns, like Bolt Rifle, Bolt Carbine, Stalker Bolter and even Heavy Bolt Rifle are always going to be more specialized and more effective at what they do no matter what. Since the gun has a very limited number of versions, its perk tree is also very, very limited and it's difficult to find a gameplay role with it. The correct move would probably be to merge it with Bolt Rifle variants, but the problem is that it would mess up with  saves too much and that drastic move is too risky.



With this update we are going to try to make it a mix of all bolters, to make that "default" gun at least more effective, but I fear that this gun will always be outshadowed by more specialized bolters.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Heavy Bolt Rifle:
[p align="start"]Headshot damage coefficient increased from 1.15 to 1.25 for all versions except Drogos Reclamation and Ophelian Liberation.



Drogos Reclamation Artificer Heavy Bolt Rifle Beta: Headshot damage coefficient increased from 1.15 to 1.35.



Ophelian Liberation Relic Heavy Bolt Rifle Beta: Headshot damage coefficient increased from 1.15 to 1.35.
[p align="start"]
MELEE[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Chainswor​d: Speed increased for all block versions.


[p align="start"]Power Sword: Speed increased for all block versions.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Thunder Hammer:

Speed increased slightly for all balanced and block versions.

AoE radius for heavy and charged melee strikes increased by 50%.

The biggest issue of the Thunder Hammer right now is its contested health recovery, not its overall effectiveness. This will be addressed during contested health recovery rework. But at the moment, we wanted to improve it so it won’t feel like a worse version of other melee weapons.


GAMEPLAY QOL[p align="start"]

Added a new charged Shield Bash attack for Bulwark class. 

With this update we are expanding Bulwark's shield moveset to make shield based perk builds more interesting. We are going to continue doing this for other classes. While we think that overall Classes balance is good, the build variety within class could be improved and this cannot be done by simply tweaking numbers.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/6857d681c0d6fd491ef0c631937425b7e535728b.png"]
BALANCING - FIREARMS[p align="start"]​
[p align="start"]Las Fusil: Charging speed decreased from 1.1 sec to 1 sec.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]​Stalker Bolt Rifle: Rate Of Fire increased from 150 shots per minute to 170 shots per minute.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]​Occulus Bolt Carbine: Full damage range increased from 20 meters to 30 meters.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]​Marksman Bolt Carbine: Headshot damage multiplier increased from 1.6 to 1.8.

[p align="start"]​Plasma Incinerator: Common Shot damage decreased by 15%.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]​Plasma damage: Fixed a bug where a player in a roll animation could not receive damage from plasma weapons.

BALANCING - MELEE

[p align="start"]​Thunder Hammer: Fixed issue that caused the Thunder Hammer to have a longer reach.
[p align="start"]
BALANCING - ABILITIES

[p align="start"]Sniper’s Camo Cloak Ability: Ability cooldown increased from 25 seconds to 35 seconds.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]​Assault’s Jump Pack Ability

Ground Pound Strike preparation time reduced by 30% for Chainsword and Power Fist. Also the new Power Axe has reduced preparation time.

Minimum height for starting preparation of Ground Pound Strike increased from 6 metres to 9 meters.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]​Bulwark: Bulwarks can now be knocked out of a shield stance if they take a lot of damage from enemies within 5 seconds.


PROGRESSION [p align="start"]Extended Weapon arsenal in PvP: Added Power Axe to Assault, Vanguard, Bulwark


[p align="start"]XP Recalculated: The amount of experience required to earn rewards has been reduced, making progression faster and more rewarding.


[p align="start"]New Levels Added: We've expanded the progression system. The new max level is 48.

OTHER PVP CHANGES 
Added new announcer eventsù

Large amount of small fixes in level geometry collision.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/440dcb58be566d6da64e4f2486616c8b1351fda6.png"]
CUSTOMISATION
Lots of minor customisation fixes.
[p align="start"]
OPERATIONS[p align="start"]Reliquary:

Enemies spawn in the tombs should now be slightly less aggressive.

The ammo crate on the Heldrake's bridge should now always spawn.
[p align="start"]All: Lots of minor fixes with level geometry.
[p align="start"]

SIEGE MODE
Lots of minor fixes with level geometry.

Lots of minor fixes with enemies getting stuck in some places.

Performance improvements.


AI[p align="start"]Carnifex: Fixed an issue causing the Carnifex to be too aggressive and too accurate with its ranged attacks.
[p align="start"]All: Lots of minor fixes with animations.
[p align="start"]
GENERAL FIXES
Fixed a bug preventing Adrenaline Surge from Block-type weapons to not stagger enemies.

Fixed a bug causing the Auspex Scan effect to not apply to enemies after a perfect parry with the class perk "Battle Focus" equipped in some rare cases.

Fixed a bug with Bulwark's "Purity of purpose" perk not dealing damage to Barbed Strangler projectiles.

Fixed a bug causing Assault’s Jump Pack ability to not land properly in some rare cases..

Lots of minor bug fixes.

Lots of minor localisation bug fixes.

Lots of minor UI fixes.


TECH
Crash fixes and general stability improvements.

General connectivity improvements.

notes.title: August Community Update
notes.content:
Greetings Space Marines,[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We hope you had a wonderful and sunny summertime. ☀️
[p align="start"]The whole team wants to thank you for the warm welcome you gave to the previous Community Update. We were so pleased to see your enthusiasm for the Chaos Spawn, Black Templars, the new PVP game mode, etc!
[p align="start"]You also asked us for news about Techmarine, and we've got some this month!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]This Community Update has a bunch of surprises and a community survey, so read it carefully! 😉
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Let’s start off with the BIG news! ✨
[p align="start"]
YEAR 2 IS JUST ROUND THE CORNER![p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We’re so close! The second year of content for Space Marine 2 is about to begin.
[p align="start"]Let’s take a look at the free content first and then DLC Content, in this trailer!



[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/CxtlJ06u_lc"][/dynamiclink]
[p align="start"]Expect the Patches to be released at a similar pace to what we were used to during the first year of content updates. Several PVE missions, the Techmarine class coming with Patch 12, cosmetics for Blood Angels, Carcharodons, Iron Hands and much more await with this Season Pass.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Check the Roadmap!
[p align="start"][img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/SpaceMarine2_Roadmap_YearTwoBattlePlan_3840x2160-1.jpg"] 
PATCH 10 - ANNIVERSARY UPDATE[p align="start"]
The Anniversary Update is planned to be rolled out on September 4! It’s a free update, but also marks the release of the Season Pass II and its first two DLCs. 📅 
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Let’s see the content of this Patch in more detail, shall we?
[p align="start"]
THE CHAOS ARMOUR PACK:[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/swaglords_driplegion.jpg"][p align="start"]The Chaos Armour Pack is coming for free. You’ll finally be able to change the armour set of your Heretic Astartes in PvP, but you’ll have to unlock the set first. Each class will require you to score a certain amount of kills per match to unlock the corresponding skin.
[p align="start"]
NEW GAME MODES: 

HELBRUTE ONSLAUGHT (PVP)[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/disturbingthepeace.jpg"][p align="start"]A brand new mode will be added with this update, and will be playable on all maps. Here’s your brief:
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Two teams of Chaos Marines will fight to control strategic areas, but also to take control of the Helbrute. The first team to take control of an objective gets to control the Helbrute, until the opposite team takes it down. One player gets to control the Helbrute at a time, and this player will be picked randomly among players who participated in securing the control point. For the team that failed to secure the first control point to have the Helbrute on their side, they will need to slay their opponents’ Helbrute and secure a new designated control point.
[p align="start"]
Controlling the Helbrute grants the team a strong advantage, but killing it rewards significant amounts of points to your team. One last thing, the Helbrute uses a Helbrute Thunder Hammer in melee, and a Plasma Cannon in range, and it can unleash a battle cry with its special skill to regenerate its HP.
[p align="start"]
STRATAGEMS (PVE)[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/itsraweceek.jpg"][p align="start"]Stratagems are a completely new PvE game mode. Unlike “classic” Operations, there are only 2 difficulty modes: “Normal” and “Hard”. What makes this new game mode different are the various Battlefield Conditions, which will change every day and week and make each operation completely different from what you’re used to. 
[p align="start"]
Battlefield Conditions can either help or hinder your progress. Upon successful completion, you will receive a new currency called “Accolades”, which can be exchanged for valuable rewards.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]There are weekly and daily Stratagems, and each Operation has their own set of modifiers. Here are a few examples of them:

Summoner: Every uninterrupted call for Reinforcements summons the Extremis enemy.

Where you aiming at: Friendly fire damage from firearms and explosives is enabled

Cadia Stands: Imperial Guards spawn on levels.

Hunted: An unkillable Lictor constantly pursues you. Dealing enough damage will scare it away for a brief time. 😈
[p align="start"]And many others that you’ll have to discover for yourself! 🤫
[p align="start"]
NEW PVP AND PVE MAPS

OPERATION: VORTEX
[p align="start"]The Astropathic Relay has once again fallen silent. Investigate and cleanse the relay of any lingering heretical presence.

[p align="start"]This map has a special, unique boss, the Mutalith Vortex Beast. We don’t want to spoil too much, you’ll have to wait for the update to drop on September 4 to discover its moveset! 😉


[p align="start"][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfI7xGN0QrETcwqCofK_NLvWVt6gVO4hPfPW67dfJUq__eQbfIW134VuPYBp0hXL_IUzyUTj0PvyMfTrT-nEsFuVYd3liltxTrvf7Irq77HwoEnIVFpRugxid828Erq2aRwC7HSfg?key=dOQE4xvpEEh4K5d6e-V9UA"]
ETERNAL WAR MAP - BRIDGE[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]A new PvP map will also be added, called “Bridge”. With long hallways and small tunnels, this map offers diversified battles and multiple possible strategies to dominate the battlefield.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Here’s how it looks:


[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/AWAWsPwdW0o?si=T-wHAYVEsaUWCBar"][/dynamiclink]
WEAPONS TO BE ADDED IN THE ARMOURY 🪓[p align="start"]
Two months ago, we showed you the Power Axe for the first time. Today, let us introduce the Power Axe in action! 
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/tqUtykgad20?si=bdJhy369zqyTpgdt"][/dynamiclink]
[p align="start"]Hero Weapon Variants will also be implemented. These variations can be exchanged against Accolades (from playing Stratagems Mode, more on that new mode below). They fall in a new mastery tier named Heroic, which is even more powerful than Relic. For example, here’s the Xenophase Blade, the Heroic version of the Power Sword, and the Combi Melta, the Heroic version of the Bolt Rifle:
[p align="start"]​
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/komm_susser_tod.png"]
[/td][td]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/thereisnotechmarine.png"]
[/td][/tr][/table]

NEW MAJORIS ENEMY: CHAOS SPAWN

[p align="start"]Brace yourself Space Marines, this one might give you a hard time. Coming with a total of 3 variations, the Chaos Spawn enters the fight. 
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Swifter and more agile than its bulk suggests, the Chaos Spawn constitutes a formidable enemy. 
[p align="start"]
Stand ready. We shall know no fear. ⚔️
[p align="start"][img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/techmarine.jpg"]
WHAT ELSE?

[p align="start"]A selection of skins that were initially unlockable through time-sensitive Community Events will be purchasable in exchange of your Accolades earned in Stratagem mode, in the "Refinement & Redemption" shop (which extends the current "Data Refinement" shop that was used until then to trade your Requisition points and Armoury Data). 
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Among them: the Porphyr Shield Chainsword Skin, the Mark X Tacticus breastplate with the 3 skulls, or the Sergeant Metaurus’s Iron Halo from the Secret Level episode. 
[p align="start"]
This patch has more surprises in store, but we've already revealed enough! Let's keep some suspense for September 4, when it will be released!


NEW DLC COSMETICS[p align="start"]The Anniversary Update brings Season Pass 2! Discover the first two Chapters available in this patch: the Black Templars and the Imperial Fists.
[p align="start"]
⚫⚪ BLACK TEMPLARS CHAMPION PACK (Bulwark) [p align="start"]​
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/bloodangelschampion.jpg"]
[/td][td]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/whydoyouevenclick.jpg"]
[/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]
The first class to receive a Champion as part of the Season Pass 2 is the Bulwark! We know how much you enjoy this class, so we naturally wanted to pair it with one of the most appreciated chapters from the Grim Dark future, the Black Templars! 
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]In addition, the Black Templars Champion Pack brings a unique skin for the Power Sword, as well as a Storm Shield and a unique Chapter Banner.
[p align="start"]​
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/SHIELD.jpg"]
[/td][td]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/bigahhsword.png"]
[/td][/tr][/table]

🟡✊ IMPERIAL FISTS COSMETIC PACK 

[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/T_is_real_2401.png"]
[/td][td]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/yellowsubamarine.png"]
[/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]
The Imperial Fists is the first returning chapter of this year’s Season Pass II! Complete your Champion Pack with over 40 new cosmetics and heraldry marking inspired by 7 of their Successor Chapters, including:

Celestial Lions

Hammers of Dorn

Invaders

Red Templar

Sons of the Phoenix

Subjugators

Crimson Fists
[p align="start"]​
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th]

[carousel][img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/yellow2-1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/8514afd1b142952e6f52c2c8d0ccd32807e94834.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/232634b92a22699a999b3edc2a5aac257c3b348f.png"][/carousel][/th][/tr][/table][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/6ddcc94673d045f93e3c5e44456dd654c6be332a.jpg"]
CHAMPION SKIN CUSTOMISATION[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Moreover, Champion skin customisation is now available. You can mix the various armour parts of the Champions, for instance you can put the Dark Angels Champion’s helmet on an Assault Marine and mix it with the Imperial Fists Champion’s pauldrons. 
[p align="start"]However, please note that not every armour part will be available for mixing in every class. For example, the Dark Angels Champion’s helmet can’t be equipped on the Sniper. 
[p align="start"]
Don’t hesitate to try the boldest combinations!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfVvKZDGdeCygxdpVZxInqEWoFwu4TUosd33cin2MeNbDk1CwCPvgC9bpN8TiQRLT2F0tyZUL2X5SlQjAKhJki4dDq15s9CzPSxqILNHxfiAwIOTgsRY6Oar-TQP5qFZLebUch1OA?key=dOQE4xvpEEh4K5d6e-V9UA"]
ANY NEWS ON THE TECHMARINE? 👀

[p align="start"]You expressed your enthusiasm after the announcement of our next class! Today, we are pleased to give you an estimated date for its implementation in the game. The Techmarine will join the ranks in early 2026 with patch 12!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]It’s yet too early to show you any designs, even a WIP asset, or to tell you more about the specificities of this Class. But if you read the Roadmap carefully, you know that he will come with his Omnissiah Axe! 😉
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We’ll keep you posted until its release. Bear with us!


THE ULTRAMARINES CHAMPION IS BACK

[p align="start"]The Ultramarines Champion Pack will be purchasable as a standalone DLC! 
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]For those who may not know, the Ultramarines Champion Pack was previously available only with the purchase of the Ultra Edition. Starting September 4, with the Anniversary Update, that will no longer be the case! Players who own the Standard or Gold Editions will now be able to purchase the UM Champion Pack separately. The pack includes a unique skin for the Heavy class as well as a matching skin for the Heavy Bolter.
[p align="start"][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe95lE5IUaTaAKAdcgmon6lI-cucRqA9Ji8y1qupSqmzRM99yn3jXPpibDM_Wh2jmGbzIWKsFtWmHeUaz8SV3I01Ud1C7aTMa2z4YSFnvfOqZ5SoAYgtJO2Lx6LbqvAh3S2ZP3K2A?key=dOQE4xvpEEh4K5d6e-V9UA"]
COMMUNITY SURVEY[p align="start"]We're looking for your feedback regarding Space Marine 2!
[p align="start"]
Your answers will help us better understand your experience with the game so that we can make the best possible improvements and future developments.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Take a few minutes to fill this survey: click here


POLL RESULTS

[p align="start"]This month, we asked you your thoughts on a possible re-balancing of the Contested Health, by reducing the amount of contested health regenerated by ranged weapons and increasing it for melee weapons. The poll received a total of 1918 votes.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]1202 of you picked in favour of a change that will increase the contested health recovery for melee weapons. You were very vocal about this potential change, let’s hear a word from our Game Director regarding this result: 
[p align="start"]

We understand that this is a very touchy subject and we will be extra careful with our changes. Ranged contested health will not be nerfed globally by tweaking 1 number. It doesn't work that way, plus there are some ranged weapons which already have inefficient ranged contested health recovery. 

Buffing melee contested health isn't going to just be increasing % value. There are certain Quality of Life features that need to be implemented for melee Contested HP to work properly (like CHP during grabs etc.). All of the changes on this subject will go through PTS testing first, so your feedback will be very much welcome.

Thanks for participating and helping us shape the future of the game!
[p align="start"]
TWITCH DROPS RETURN[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]From September 4, 2025 (04:00 pm CEST) to September 18, 2025 (04:00 pm CEST), Twitch Drop returns with in-game rewards! Watch any Space Marine 2 stream to unlock:

Watch 30 minutes to earn the Mark X Skull Breastplate.

Watch 1 hour to earn the Mark X Pristine Aquila Breastplate.

Watch 2 hours to earn the Porphyr Shield Power Axe skin.
[p align="start"]​
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td]
​[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/1-Mark_X_Vertex_Breastplate.png"]
[/td][td]
​[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/3-Porphyr_Shield_Power_Axe.png"]
[/td][td]
​[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/mzulft/2-Mark_X_Pristine_Aquila_Breastplate.png"]
[/td][/tr][/table]

THAT’S IT FOR THIS MONTH

[p align="start"]As per usual, follow us on our socials to be updated with the latest news, and join the official Discord server along with the 70,000 other Space Marines already there!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Thank you for your unwavering support.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]-Focus and Saber

notes.title: Here's the Year 2 Roadmap and the Anniversary Update's content!
notes.content:
Greeting Space Marines,[p align="justify"]We've excited to reveal our Year 2 plans for Space Marine 2, starting with the release of the Anniversary Update on September 4. 
[p align="justify"]You're in for another year of free gameplay content, in addition to a new Season Pass bursting with new cosmetics!! 🎉

Check out our Year 2 Trailer!

[previewyoutube="CxtlJ06u_lc;full"][/previewyoutube]
🆕 New game modes, Operations, PvP arenas and much, much more

[p align="justify"]Space Marine 2’s Year 2 content follows in the footsteps of Year 1 with 6 new planned patches packed with free gameplay additions available to all players throughout 2025 and 2026. From new PvE and PvP game modes to new enemies and a new playable class, defenders of Humanity are in for a treat:
[p align="justify"]4 new Operations & a new Siege map
[p align="justify"]3 new Eternal War arenas
[p align="justify"]New Stratagems (PvE) and Helbrute Onslaught (PvP) game modes
[p align="justify"]New playable class: The Techmarine
[p align="justify"]New weapons and free unlockable weapon variants for existing weapons
[p align="justify"]New enemies and bosses
[p align="justify"]New Progression mechanics


This second year of content kicks off on September 4 with the release of Space Marine 2’s Anniversary Update, its biggest patch to date. Find out more with our Year 2 Roadmap below.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/d3a1213f58fff305b9b9832b9da4b3a239301198.jpg"]
✨ More Space Marine Chapter cosmetics with the Season Pass II[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]September 4’s Anniversary Update also comes with the release of Space Marine 2’s second Season Pass and its first two DLCs: the Black Templars Champion Pack and Imperial Fists Cosmetic Pack, including a new Champion skin for the Bulwark class and Power Sword skin for the former, and over 40 new cosmetics celebrating 7 of the Imperial Fists’ Successor Chapters for the latter. 
[p align="justify"]
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/9df7d9dcb17435ab8ad20ff334c575c1a6dbafd0.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/ea1e946886ac4811d72a936131bcbca78dc38b36.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/256101909d162cb4d6b09d3878ed4bd20e695da4.jpg"][/carousel][p align="justify"]Throughout the year, the Season Pass II will grant players 9 new DLCs celebrating the galaxy-spanning variety of Space Marine Chapters with new Champion skins, armour pieces and heraldry markings. While existing Chapters like the Blood Angels and Salamanders are to receive new cosmetics, fan-favorite Chapters like the Raptors, Iron Hands and Carcharodons will get their due time in the spotlight. 


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/1028110d82d8b08322809f7e0affd4c9784a5d0d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/8514afd1b142952e6f52c2c8d0ccd32807e94834.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/232634b92a22699a999b3edc2a5aac257c3b348f.png"][/carousel]
Heed the call of battle once again on September 4th with Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2’s “Anniversary” update, available for free, and receive a ton of new customisation options with the Season Pass II. 



Join the Space Marine 2 community, share feedback, and get exclusive rewards on our new Focus Together platform.

notes.title: July Community Update
notes.content:
Hello Space Marines,


Since it’s summer and everyone deserves a break, please expect fewer updates in August. This Community Update will be shorter than usual, but we promise it’s filled with good news!


[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/hylia/SM2_Separateur_1920.png"]


A WHOLE NEW YEAR OF FREE CONTENT IS COMING 🎁


As announced last month, a second year of content is in the making, with both free and DLC content. This second year means a new Season Pass too! This new Season Pass will grant players access to the new DLC content. Overall, it will work the same way as Year 1 did. Let’s see what’s going to be free:


NEW PVP MAP 🗺️


Let’s begin with the new PvP map. Set on Avarax, it is a mix of close quarters and long hallways. This fifth map will be available for every PvP game mode.

​
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcYlHu6RTxkUdk0oHW1ERWVbKEkeMly4w5o5uASzRnhqUxtrulybkltzyBhZcx29S3JXB0r8UJleJiQzG9CwgxnE0Q9Oy8uUR_SzW9UHzsJcMsc9roSfZeeHgSpaRX_17QD1xnAIg?key=BoPYub_ZPXTGzX9cL1X1EA"]
[/td][td]
[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdPBpfGDSgK5xXRvUJ7edPGV02SHuqnBMFBOuaIoQTIAHk0gbvUEBvrCMlKU-0CB_85gdrs7LBCZsOANpCMwB_4LjNMhD8NW6qM4FbgN0VcNAZMpt2r6T8gJWflD_s9VzA9Z4iFLA?key=BoPYub_ZPXTGzX9cL1X1EA"]
[/td][/tr][/table]
Development still ongoing, final version subject to change.

NEW GAME MODE: HELBRUTE ONSLAUGHT 🩸


This new map will be introduced with Patch 10.0, and will coincide with the release of the new PvP game mode ​​“Helbrute Onslaught”. 


Two teams of Chaos Marines will fight to control strategic areas, but also to take control of the Helbrute. The first team to take control of an objective gets to control the Helbrute, until the opposite team takes it down. One player gets to control the Helbrute at a time, and this player will be picked randomly among players who participated in securing the control point. To have the Helbrute on their side, the team that failed to secure the first control point will need to slay the Helbrute before securing a new designated control point. Controlling the Helbrute grants the team a strong advantage, but killing it will also reward points to the opposite team. 



The Helbrute uses a Helbrute Thunder Hammer in melee, and a Plasma Cannon in range. 

NEW WEAPONS: PYRECANNON 🔥🔥🔥


New weapons will also be added! Last month, we revealed the Power Axe, this month we’re happy to show you the Pyrecannon! This weapon is ideal to dispatch the hordes.

​
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf-ar9q2JtQntkCJVuMeFJ0joFnNTvMyIivdHoDp1EX-cVT-N-uj9kCo1bs5SUChfUr0FxpE9GJxILcuBm39QuUZO2P9lcXJaeDw9OgE-Xn0-52NNbxKf6emgek8VUS7Ai3aO8I-g?key=BoPYub_ZPXTGzX9cL1X1EA"]
[/td][td]
[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcLJmuc-GHEgFXp4AGyZk-x9Wo_A2JUBYIbmiiES_iHEV-99XHaOHesccHw25TCzitdAHvLUHcQtsnet9KW-lgyud_ARW6fJMike6irYzF74VzgshK8-7M_5tkjwjABuCPBCk6v?key=BoPYub_ZPXTGzX9cL1X1EA"]
[/td][/tr][/table]

NEW MAJORIS ENEMY: CHAOS SPAWN 😈


A new Majoris enemy will also reinforce the Chaos forces: the Chaos Spawn. This abomination has 3 different variations, each with their own moveset and abilities. Take a look at one of them:

[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/hylia/chaos_spanw,_cropped.png"]
NEW GAME MODE AND MODIFIERS 🔁


Finally, a new variation will be added to PvE to bring replayability to the game. Some of you might remember when the 4.0 update brought a modifier that forced team members to stay close to each other to get their shield back. Following your feedback, we decided to remove this feature to rework it and bring it back later, integrated in a new game mode, along with new gameplay modifiers each week. 


This new game mode will come with Patch 10.0 (the specific modifier mentioned above will be implemented later, though). New free cosmetics and exotic weapons will also be granted for the completion of this new challenge. Stay tuned, we’ll reveal more on that later. 




[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/hylia/SM2_Separateur_1920-1.png"]


THE YEAR 2 SEASON PASS IS ON ITS WAY 🎫2️⃣


Without spoiling too much, we can already tease you about a few things:

First of all, the Black Templar Champion will be the first Champion of the Year 2 Season Pass (coming with Patch 10.0). It will be associated with the Bulwark class. 

There will be brand new Chapters, as well as returning Chapters.

And last but not least: this second Season Pass is coming with Patch 10.0 and will be available for purchase in September! 🗓️ 



[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/hylia/SM2_Separateur_1920-2.png"]


JULY COMMUNITY EVENT


Experience rewards for Siege are currently increased by 50% from July 29 to August 5. 🩸



[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfwaXkVPdd-FBQ19iLACI2hKzigal7qQZvKepTbDh3hRSbT_NogrEfLqAynVs4GBuQaCtp5aUMx9hhJYV6r5LsxlpZRMfoVDgX_MIw3yCJ1Nr01Dnvh3ctv4Cst8fhQez7psR1p3g?key=BoPYub_ZPXTGzX9cL1X1EA"]



[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/hylia/SM2_Separateur_1920-3.png"]


HOTFIX 8.1
Following the release of the 8.0 Siege Update, some of you reported connection instability, and crashes. The 8.1 Hotfix aimed to fix these issues. You can check out the full changelog here ⚙️ 


PATCH 9.0
Patch 9.0 was rolled out a few days ago. You can read the patch notes here.



We saw your feedback on blocking weapons being too slow now. The goal of the patch was to establish an even field for all of the weapon variants and simplify weapon progression rules with almost 100 different weapon variants saw changes. We will continue to work with your feedback and make necessary adjustments.


[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfdQeJsbkdZDnuSouMABNyDo9-E8cylu_skhVnaDwKtQantdfpvih7gTeV1AMhNxpH_v7LIJ4jhnuriGD3EcQlOIzEjASfXhZrscYjMA8EsWl2iQrFthNhWZl8YiUXRwGCteiNf?key=BoPYub_ZPXTGzX9cL1X1EA"]

Also, we wish to acknowledge the persistent connectivity issues. While this patch won’t fully solve them, please know that we’re actively investigating the root causes and continuing to work toward a long-term solution.  




[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/hylia/SM2_Separateur_1920-4.png"]


THAT’S IT FOR THIS MONTH


We wanted to wish you all a good summer time and relaxing holidays if you’re lucky enough to have some! If not… don’t forget you have duty elsewhere, Space Marine 🫡

As per usual, follow us on our socials to be updated with the latest news, and join the official Discord server along with the 70,000 other Space Marines already there!



Thank you for your unwavering support.



- Focus and Saber

notes.title: New Space Marine 2 update buffs basically every gun, reworks Assault class
notes.content:
I'm still waiting for the Iron Hands to be added to Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2 properly. I know they've got a paint scheme and that's more than most Chaos legions can say, but I want some proper bionics, augmented limbs, and 17 Servo Skulls to follow me round as I beam Multi-Melta shots at Carnifexes. Thankfully, Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2's Patch 9.0 gives me a little hope. There's no sign of my kitted-out Iron Hands skin, but at least my beloved Multi-Melta got a buff. And my Heavy Bolter. And the Las Fusil. Wait, were there any weapons that didn't get buffs in this patch?
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Patch 9.0 - Quality of Life Update is live!
notes.content:
​Hello Space Marines,


The 9.0 - QoL Update is live now on every platform. ⚙️

This patch brings lots of balancing tweaks in both PVP and PVE, including Siege Mode. It also aims to improve stability issues and fix crashes.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/a70306b9ee644d2831a59d425d4e0a3fd79dc557.png"]



Here are the topics covered, in order:

Datavault Update

Gameplay and Balancing tweaks

PVE melee weapons

PVE firearm weapons

Class Perks update

Firearms (PVE only)

Combat - quality of life

Siege Mode

PVP

AI

Customisation

General fixes

Tech



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/3ec4325278817829f901c1d0db2d0ab7ea091cdc.png"]
DATAVAULT UPDATE

New Datavault reward screen, with updated UX

New entity Trygon in the Tyranids tab in the Datavault


[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td]
We are adjusting Datavault UI and internal unlock logic to make it expandable in the future, so adding new entries to it would not affect already given out rewards.

- Dmitry Grigorenko, Game Director.
[/td][/tr][/table]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/96a5d04b30efd2f21c477578b3b46a470b110a41.png"]
GAMEPLAY AND BALANCING TWEAKS


Assault Ground Pound Damage:

Chainsword and Power Sword ground pound damage increased to match Power Fist and Thunder Hammer's one.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td]
Power Sword ground pound damage got buffed in Patch 8.0 but wasn't listed in the previous patch notes. This change should add more variety to Assault's class builds, because all of the "one-shot" builds implied having a Thunder Hammer or a Power Fist exclusively.

- Dmitry Grigorenko, Game Director.
[/td][/tr][/table]




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/b344e692d4bd38cec0d6623b76a9461d62da1ced.png"]
PVE MELEE WEAPONS

[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td]
With this update we want to rework all of the melee weapon versions. The stats distribution was too complex between different tiers and wasn't following the same ruleset as firearms, where Relic tier weapons are strictly better than Artificer ones.

This is a massive overhaul and a lot of popular versions may become less effective than they used to be and vice versa. We are going to make another pass at this if necessary, but we think that we need to do a clean up here first to move forward.

- Dmitry Grigorenko, Game Director.
[/td][/tr][/table]


PvE Melee Weapon Progression Update

Progression for all melee weapons has been updated to streamline the experience. Relic versions of the melee weapons will now always have better stats than artificer weapons and distribution of the stats is going to follow these principles:

­

Balanced weapons have moderate damage and moderate speed.

Fencing weapons offer the fastest speed but have the lowest damage.

Block weapons are the slowest but deliver the highest damage.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/24b1108979ed6564748cf27c4dd9a8cdd191b5b5.png"]
PVE FIREARM WEAPONS

[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td]
Our stats show that all of the firearms balance is in a good spot right now and all weapons are Absolute viable. While some of the weapon archetypes are more popular and more effective than the other ones, with this patch we wanted to focus on actual versions' balance. 

Some of the versions within archetype were underpicked and thus we would like to do a big pass on those, obviously. But in addition to that we feel like some of the versions didn't stand out much from their counterparts. Therefore, we wanted to increase the stats difference to make sure that the choice is more meaningful.

- Dmitry Grigorenko, Game Director.
[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: June Community Update
notes.content:
Hello Space Marines!


A few days ago, we released Patch 8.0 - Siege Update, including the Siege Mode, White Scars and Blood Angels Cosmetics, along with several improvements and minor changes. If you haven’t already, you should definitely read the full patch here.


[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfnMHm-HvSI5LHVaMNjbipHYJAL34Q1SMZhHaaIfa-l9Zf1CPwlHzIrUjnU7QL0gzqqt-7MlpGl8gQtHOqymJn7atNKCr82Z_JPMDvi35RmyDD8tJy0HeTbahL7e1HuBKMeMkXm2A?key=EmFw4LBOwmmVaxw8jiOYWA"]

Now let’s rewind a bit, and mostly: let’s discuss what’s coming as the first year of content is slowly coming to an end. Shall we?


WHAT COMES AFTER YEAR ONE? 🧐


As promised, we’re excited to share more details with you, and even more will be revealed in the upcoming Community Updates this July and August. For now, here are a few things we can confirm:



We’re happy to announce that a second year of both free and DLC content included in a new yearly season pass is on the way! This extended support to Space Marine 2 has been possible thanks to your unwavering support, so once again, thank you very much for being part of it!. Expect new PvE missions, enemies, weapons, and… more 👀 It’s too early to provide more info, but stay tuned! 😉


Also, to celebrate the first anniversary of the game, a large-scale update is planned for September, the 10.0 major update. Update 9.0 will not bring new content, but only balancing changes.


Unfortunately, that also means that the new PvP mode we were planning to release alongside the 9.0 update will be postponed to this big 10.0 update as well. While we can’t show you how it looks, the least we can do is to reveal what this new mode will be about:

This new mode will take place on a new map.

It will oppose 2 sides, but it won’t be Loyalist VS Chaos like in regular PvP. Instead, Chaos will face… Chaos.

Last but not least, you’ll be able to take control of the Helbrute. Yup.

As this new game mode is centered around Chaos, new Chaos armours will also be added to the game.


A new melee weapon will also be added as part of this big 10.0 Update: the Power Axe! It will have its own moveset, execution animations etc… We’ll show you more on this weapon later on, but here’s a first look!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/b9d4da70b5f382d137a5fc2c8a7c87556b8e5053.png"]Work in progress, final version is subject to change


Finally, we announced a while ago that we are working on a new class for PvE and PvP. We’re now advanced enough in its development to announce that the new class will be a Techmarine! We’ll reveal more about this new class in the next community updates, so stay tuned! 


PATCH 8.0 IN DETAILS ⚙️


Patch 8.0 - Siege Update was available via the Public Test Server on Steam. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made a bunch of tweaks and improvements for the live game release of the Patch. So, thank you for your participation! Let’s briefly review the content, or read the full patch notes for more details!


SIEGE MODE
Siege Mode is the new big feature coming with the Siege Update! Check the May Community Update for more details about the gameplay mechanics of this mode.



For those who played on the PTS and provided us with feedback, we heard you loud and clear! You expressed your disappointment regarding the timer. So we changed it a bit. Now, it goes as follows:




⏱️ The timer has changed!⏱️

The biggest criticism regarding Siege mode from the community was the wave timer limit. It exists only for technical reasons, because killing lots of enemies causes memory fragmentation (which, to simplify, would cause a crash after a certain threshold).



We've made some optimizations so the Siege mode can last longer. Timer got reworked, instead of having a limited timer per wave that can get to a very short time on higher waves, there is a timer for the entire session and each time you beat a wave the timer increases. We've also adjusted the difficulty curve of infinite waves so enemies will get stronger faster after the 15th wave. These changes will make players die in fair combat rather than due to the timer. 

Also, with some optimizations coming down later we think we can get rid of the timer entirely.

We truly hope you’re enjoying Siege Mode as much as we are and we’re still open to feedback!

notes.content:

notes.title: The Siege Update is now available! 🩸
notes.content:
The Siege Update is OUT! 🙌


The long-awaited Siege Update, adding a new PVE mode as well as new Cosmetic DLCs and rewards is now live for everyone! Play now!


Check out our Siege Update Trailer![previewyoutube="AhLjF4CCvDk;full"][/previewyoutube]

⚔️ Tear down endless waves of Tyranids and Heretics


Fight against impossible odds in Space Marine 2’s Siege Mode, a new PvE experience available for free to all players today. Set on Kadaku, this new 3-player game mode pits you against ever deadlier waves of Tyranid and Thousand Sons, daring you and your squad to hold an imperial fortress for as long as you possibly can.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/e7a5450c1d6579a0b3b5eb7d5822bcb9ad53785f.png"]



Earn points with each wave you defeat and spend them at Requisition Terminals to stay in the fight. Ammunition, equipment charges and Medicae Stimms will keep you upright but as the going gets tough, spending your points on reinforcements like Cadian regiments or Dreadnought support will prove invaluable! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/cde1949bb829592a9725ec5d52274f6c21cb38a0.png"]

Every five waves, you and your squad will be called upon to defend a new area of the fortress, if you’re able to defeat the Carnifexes, Neurothropes and Helbrutes throwing themselves at you, that is.

Extract before it’s too late to earn Requisition Points, Armoury Data and XP, or fulfill your duty to the Emperor, for only in death does duty end.


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/bf065a96141e1064f170b23913e0d1d88a01014a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/a886eca2aa63f2286779c4eb3da2327ba67a95ca.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/54092cea0d14719c1212fec77623e0600b065b01.jpg"][/carousel]

In addition to the new Siege Mode, today’s Patch 8 update comes with two new DLCs for Ultra Edition, Gold Edition, and Season Pass holders. 



The White Scars Chapter Pack includes a new Champion skin for the Assault class; three exclusive White Scars-inspired weapon skins for the Occulus Bolt Carbine, Stalker Bolt Rifle, and Combat Knife; and a host of cosmetic options and heraldry markings for their Successor Chapters. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/b066256ea388e1db5bd6cd8e09d0c10107cd25eb.jpg"]

The Blood Angels Cosmetic Pack provides three new armour pieces which may be equipped on any of the game’s playable classes, and a suite of heraldry symbols and rank markings celebrating eight of the Blood Angels’ Successor Chapters.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/e9b00e197758eebd0757f8b7881c56347bd9766e.jpg"]
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/46d0d37e4263b8b2ba15f7bd6d5127e61871dc7b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/2fb39e0f5017cf83ce924c48783bd696c67ac436.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/6b8123edd3debacc0b18ab3e0d9d99dd7d4347a5.jpg"][/carousel]A few changes and additions

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/c79affde4a2a8c9d04e938a6f60af8301573efbb.png"]

notes.title: Patch Notes 8.0 - Siege Update
notes.content:
​Hi Space Marines!


The 8.0 “Siege update” is now live on every platform! Here’s a quick summary of its content:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/ecbb29f9efaa85dbb69f458e2fd5c0a1cb1c9551.jpg"]
New Features


New PvE Mode — Siege

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/e7a5450c1d6579a0b3b5eb7d5822bcb9ad53785f.png"]

Siege Mode expands on our PVE operations, emphasizing endless enemy waves that challenge even the strongest teams. When overwhelmed, players may call reinforcements for assistance. Engage in intense battles across three distinctive sectors, each requiring strategic adaptation. Side objectives emerge during combat, providing essential resources used to summon elite Space Marines or a formidable Dreadnought, drastically shifting battlefield dynamics.


The Battlefield
The battle unfolds within a fortified Imperial stronghold on Kadaku, relentlessly attacked by endless waves of Tyranid and Thousand Sons enemies. The fortress has three rotating sectors: Defensive Positions, the Arsenal, and the Control Room. In each sector, you will face five waves of enemies before your squad advances to the next sector, ultimately cycling back to reinforce earlier positions.


Survival Against Waves
Face increasingly challenging enemy waves, with direct assaults from Tyranids and cunning sabotage by Chaos forces. Brief (1 minute) intermissions between waves offer strategic opportunities, clearly indicated through UI notifications.


Side Objectives
Dynamic tasks such as capturing strategic points or retrieving Data-slates from fallen allies deepen tactical gameplay and supply critical resources essential for continued survival.


Shop and Reinforcements
Earn Siege Mode resources through successful combat and Side Objective completion. You can spend these resources at the fortress Shop. You can:


[olist]
Buy ammunition, medicae stimms, equipment, armour boosts, guardian relic (these items have the same exact behaviour as in Operations Mode).

Summon specialized Space Marines providing targeted support and bonuses. Each player can have only one summoned Space Marine.

Deploy Cadian Troopers to provide additional firepower. 
[/olist]
Note about reinforcements changes from the PTS: guardsmen are now cheaper.



      4. Collectively pool your resources to unleash the devastating power of a Dreadnought.



[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfviEfHvwlz6aYq4r2sr-HTPRk9J5hQmhb8nTnIV7TbrtKKWNlf9WdONqHsTF6IGKtvcWw0CV7NLt77aOj7FljNuI0ZRgY3aA8r3Hk6c7QnteRqgQJzXTdEKoeFjlYK0QwBb6ro?key=gnyzwl0aHXvpELg_kEjf1g"]
Boss Encounters
Every fifth wave introduces formidable boss battles, occasionally facing multiple elite foes simultaneously. Triumph in these encounters to progress to new fortress sectors.


Infinite Waves
If your resolve endures through fifteen brutal waves, prepare for endless combat of increasing difficulty, reduced resources, and shorter preparation times. Even the Primarch of the Ultramarines understands that ultimate victory here is unlikely — but your bravery will echo through the halls of eternity.


Note about timer changes from PTS:
The biggest criticism regarding Siege mode from the community was the wave timer limit. It exists only for technical reasons. In this build we've made some optimizations so the Siege mode can last longer. 



Timer got reworked, instead of having a limited timer per wave that can get to a very short time on higher waves, there is a timer for the entire session and each time you beat a wave the timer increases. 



We've also adjusted the difficulty curve of infinite waves so enemies will get stronger faster after the 15th wave. These changes will make players die in fair combat rather than due to the timer. Also, with some optimizations coming down later we think we can get rid of the timer entirely.



Added an option to disable bots spawn in Private Mode

Perfect if you’re looking for a challenge.



RTAO experimental feature added — enables in in-game video settings

DLSS 4  — better upscale, multiframe generation in NVIDIA settings for 50xx series cards.



[img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXenLPQDlFcQgBWG82J2E0FVxKbS3YGnb-X8L64V4QbpFJp4Sst7CrY8Yug3GSO5etQJ0Si4qExbqhYYQjs75_Za_ZcPsmT2_pFsBcVOR-1oMQ5UNl96RXtLXDvOzxdf3JTgMq2UPg?key=gnyzwl0aHXvpELg_kEjf1g"]
New Season Pass Content
Added White Scars Chapter Champion. 

Added White Scars Chapter Weapon Skin Pack. 

Added White Scars Chapter Customisation Pack. 

Added Blood Angels Customisation Pack.


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/b066256ea388e1db5bd6cd8e09d0c10107cd25eb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/9f0a261a65d0e9e65f99d2e59ec33868f81f85c4.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/0254e5bfaa406e0d3d52e12db225d7cd3bd87237.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/c0fc4a0e132d08919324e6e27654fe15b3958f0a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/b73fa5f9b8a36fa2e713d59c294a66e6f6151489.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/b4c834898fa174b67debd3bf94cb8ed02cab7f98.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/6db692fa5ef96c40a3454b8eafdfcf58f7d9b219.jpg"][/carousel]



[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/e9b00e197758eebd0757f8b7881c56347bd9766e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/2fb39e0f5017cf83ce924c48783bd696c67ac436.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/46d0d37e4263b8b2ba15f7bd6d5127e61871dc7b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/6b8123edd3debacc0b18ab3e0d9d99dd7d4347a5.jpg"][/carousel]

GAMEPLAY AND BALANCING TWEAKS

Extended Weapon arsenal in PvE 
Added Thunder Hammer for Bulwark. Picking this weapon won’t allow you to use the Storm Shield.

We are adding this option only because we think it will be very cool and it's a shame that only 1 class can use the Thunder Hammer. We are not done with Bulwark, more interesting gameplay things are to come.


New Finishers for Bulwark
Adding new finishers for Bulwark with shield — 1 for Hormagaunt and 1 for Tzaangor.


Terminus Update for Absolute Difficulty 
A second Terminus can now appear during a mission.

Carnifex, Neurothrope and Helbrute HP increased by 33% on Absolute difficulty.

Level specific Terminus enemies (with the exception of the Hierophant Bio-Titan) HP increased by 66% on Absolute difficulty.

Additional enemy packs will appear upon Terminus enemies spawn and again when their HP is reduced to 50%

These additional packs are now slightly more challenging featuring more Extremis enemies

Mission with final bosses can now also spawn Terminus enemies (previously, missions like “Decapitation” didn't allow any Terminus spawns)".

This change is made according to the community poll that we made a while ago. We think that Absolute difficulty wasn't that hard to begin with and now with a slight power creep of constant weapons buffs, perk buffs and prestige perks the situation is much worse.



After doing multiple test we have scrapped the idea of having 2 Terminus enemies in Operations mode at the same time (except in Siege mode), because this meant that you would have to encounter them all of the time, otherwise one run with dual terminus spawns would be much harder than a run with 2 Terminus enemies spawning one by one. We are increasing the health of the Terminus enemies on Absolute difficulty because they often can die before even dealing any damage. While this may seem like it goes against poll results, keep in mind that if we had 2 Terminus enemies, that would effectively be +100%  hp buff. Also we are nerfing Neurothrope base hp across all difficulty levels so its hp pool won’t become a problem for melee classes.



Instead we've tried to make Terminus spawns harder and more intense. We are going to continue to monitor how Absolute Difficulty is, and make necessary tweaks.


Prestige Perks Class Update

Bulwark Prestige Perks Update
“Rally Point”: The perk has been reworked. The new perk is “Emboldened Stand”.

Old: “Chapter Banner additionally removes negative Status Effects while active.”

New: “When the Chapter Banner is active, all Squad Members do not lose control upon taking Heavy Hits and cannot be knocked back within its zone.”




Assault Prestige Perks Update
"Boosted Recharge": The perk has been reworked. The new perk is “Unyielding Oath”.

Old: “Collecting an Armour Boost restores Ability Charge by 100%.”

New: "When charging a Ground Pound, you become Invulnerable for 3 seconds."




Sniper Prestige Perks Update
"Boosted Recharge": The perk has been reworked. The new perk is “Materiel Upgrade”.

Old: “Collecting an Armour Boost restores Ability Charge by 100%.”

New: "Equipment Damage radius increases by 15%."




Heavy Prestige Perks Update
“Restorative Capacity”: The perk has been reworked. The new perk is “Honed Precision”.

Old: ” Activating Iron Halo removes negative Status Effects.”

New: "Equipped Weapon's Maximum Spread decreases by 25% when firing without aiming."




Tactical Prestige Perks Update
"Skilled Supplier":  Fixed a bug preventing the player from getting the maximum ammo.


Class Perks Updates

Bulwark Perks Update 


Perks have been updated to reflect the addition of the Thunder Hammer to the Bulwark’s arsenal. 



"Forward Momentum": The perk has been updated. 

Old: “After a Shield Bash, Melee Damage increases by 30% for 10 seconds.”

New: "After a Shield Bash or Thunder Hammer Pommel Smash, Melee Damage increases by 30% for 10 seconds".



"Concussive Force": The perk has been updated.

Old: “Shield Bash deals 200% more Damage.”

New: "Shield Bash deals 200% more Damage. Thunder Hammer Pommel Smash deals 100% more Damage and deals area-of-effect Damage within a 7-metre radius. Cooldown is 5 seconds."



"Merciless Resolve": The perk has been updated.

Old: “After a Shield Bash, Melee Damage increases by 15%, you do not lose control upon taking Heavy Hits and you cannot be knocked back for 10 seconds”

New: "After a Shield Bash or Thunder Hammer Pommel Smash, Melee Damage increases by 15%, you do not lose control upon taking Heavy Hits, and you cannot be knocked back for 10 seconds".



"Focused Restoration": The perk has been buffed.

“Every 40 seconds, all Squad Members automatically restore 1 Armour Segment “ ->  Cooldown decreased from 40 to 30 seconds.




Tactical Perks Update
"Final Shot": The perk has been reworked. The new perk is “Emperor’s Judgement”.

Old: “After a Finisher, the equipped Ranged Weapon reloads automatically.”

New:"After a Finisher, the equipped Ranged Weapon reloads automatically, and your Primary Weapon deals 20% more Damage for 10 seconds".



"Communion of Fire": The perk has been reworked. The new perk is “Secure Stockpile”.

Old: “Recoil is reduced by 25% and Ranged damage against Extremis-level enemies is increased by 10% for all Squad Members.”

New: “Equipment Charge is restored by 1 for all Squad Members. Cooldown is 60 seconds.”



"Steady Aim": The perk has been buffed.

“Weapon Spread and Recoil is reduced by 20% and Ranged Damage against Terminus-level enemies is increased by 10%” -> Ranged Damage bonus increased from 10% to 15%.




Assault Perks Update
"Winged Fury": The perk has been buffed

“Damage from Melee Attacks executed while sprinting or dashing increases by 40%.” -> Damage increased from 40% to 100%.



"Hammer of Wrath": The perk has been buffed.

“After a Ground Pound, you take 15% less Ranged Damage, do not lose control upon taking Heavy Hits and you cannot be knocked back for 10 seconds” -> Damage reduction increased from 15% to 20%. Knock back immunity duration increased from 10 to 15 seconds.




Vanguard Perks Update
"Moving Target": The perk has been buffed.

“Each Melee Attack you land reduces the Ranged Damage you take by 2% (up to 20%). If you do not land a Melee Attack for 5 seconds, the effect ends.” ->  Consecutive hit multiplier increased from 2% to 5%. Max bonus increased from 20% to 30%.



"Retribution": The perk has been buffed.

“After you are grabbed or knocked back, you deal 25% more Melee Damage for 15 seconds.” -> Bonus damage increased from 25% to 30%. Duration increased from 15 to 20 seconds.




Sniper Perks Update
"Precision Targeting": The perk has been buffed.

“Weapon Spread is reduced by 25% and Ranged Damage against Extremis-level enemies is increased by 10% for all Squad Members.” -> Ranged Damage against Extremis-level enemies increased from 10 to 15%.



"Dexterous Hands": Instigator Bolt Carbine is now also affected.

“Bolt Carbines reload 20% faster, and their Weapon Spread and Recoil are reduced by 15%.”




Weapon Perks Update

Inferno Pistol Perk Update
"Know no fear": The perk has been reworked. 

Old: “When your Health is below 10%, Reload Speed increases by 30%”

New: “If your Armour is fully depleted, Reload Speed increases by 20%.”




Neo-Volkite Pistol Perk Update
"Combustive momentum": The perk has been buffed.

“After a Gun Strike, heating speed increases by 30% for 6 seconds.” -> Duration increased from 2 to 6 seconds.




Combat QoL
If a Sniper type enemy aims at you, using Assault’s Jump Pack ability will allow you to dodge the shot. The sniper will shoot instantly, but the shot will miss.



Fixed an issue where Neurothropes' Warp Storm afterblasts could stun-lock the player with heavy hits. Now, afterblasts will damage the player but not control them. Additionally, Neurothropes' shots now have a slightly longer delay between them.



Fixed a lot of minor issues improving overall combat responsiveness 




Firearms (PvE Only)
There are not many weapon balance tweaks in this patch because our statistics show that usage and win rate for all weapons is in a good spot right now. With the next big update we are going to focus on weapon versions balance inside each archetype, because this is where we see a big room for improvements.


Bolt Pistol
Hip-Fire spread decreased by 50%. 

Velocity of spread increasing in minizoom state is decreased by 15%.


Inferno Pistol
Gun Strike Damage increased by 20%.


PvP
With the next patch we are going to take a closer look at PvP weapon balance.

Large amount of small fixes in level geometry collision.

Lots of minor fixes for private lobbies gameplay modifiers.


AI
Spore Mines: Explosion damage is reduced by 55%.

Neurothrope:

Health reduced by 15%

Temporary invulnerability is replaced with high damage resistance when it flies up from the ground.

Lots of minor animation fixes for various enemies.


Customisation
We are preparing a very big update for customisation, players will be able to reuse chapter champion armour parts on other classes (with lore accuracy, clipping and technical restrictions). While it's not going to be in this patch, we wanted to mention this in this patch notes to assure you that we are going to continue expanding our customization system.

Added Red, White and Blue weapon skins as Siege mode rewards

Added Prestige reward shoulder pad on left shoulder as well.

Added left pauldron decal "Ultramarine Sergeant".

Lots of other minor fixes for customizations of armour parts and emblems.


Levels
Large amounts of small fixes in level geometry collision and Terminus enemies getting stuck in some areas.


General Fixes
Fixed an issue where spore mines could spawn on top of the player.

Fixed several cases where contested health may decrease while performing a finisher.

Fixed: Combining Sniper's prestige perk Emperor's Grace with Lingering Concealment perk drains the ability charge while linger is active

Fixed: Weapon perk "Reloaded Restauration" was not activated by the Sniper's perk "Efficient Readiness".

Fixed an issue where the Bulwark perk’s “Intimidating Aura” was not triggering with a Perfect Block.

Fixed an issue where the Tactical’s perk’s “Battle Focus” was not triggering with a Perfect Block.

Intimidating Aura and Battle Focus are probably the most overpowered perks right now, but we think that it should still work independently from selected weapon

Fixed a bug with the “Final Shot” perk not increasing damage in some cases.

Fixed a bug affecting Heavy's “Bonds of brotherhood” perk not granting full health when the player is revived by a bot.

Fixed an issue provoking a game freeze on a black screen at the end of a PvE level on Xbox Series S.

Fixed an issue where some pick ups were inaccessible as a consequence of the interaction button failing to appear. 

Fixed rare camera bugs after finisher.

Lots of minor animation fixes for the player.

Minor UI, sound and VFX fixes and improvements


Tech
Crash fixes and general stability improvements.

Matchmaking and network stability fixes.

Minor memory optimization. 

Improvements to game modding capabilities.
