notes.title: The Public Test Server opens once again!
notes.content:
Hi Space Marines! ⭐ 

The Public Test Server opens once more today! Check out this quick FAQ to help you get started and ready before launch.
‎ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/0a6ea410f462d2a5b6950db04e11ef0cb86b247b.png
‎ 

What’s a Public Test Server?

Space Marine 2’s Public Test Server works as a separate version of the game featuring WIP content and features. Share your feedback to help us refine the patch before its official release. Your input provides an important perspective that will be reviewed by the developer team and have an impact on further game updates.

Since this is a test environment, expect the unfinished content and possible bugs. As you will access it through a different game version, your progression will not be tracked. For each PTS update, you will land on the game with levels maxed out and all weapons unlocked.

Please note that the DLCs won’t be available, regardless of whether you own them.
‎ 
Since the PTS is "Public", you are free to create content based on it. No NDA will be included.

Which platforms can access the PTS?

The PTS is only available on PC via Steam. It is not accessible on consoles (PlayStation/Xbox) or through the Epic Games Store.

Now, let’s see how to install it 👇
‎ 

📝 Tutorial on how to access PTS via Steam:

Just follow these simple steps:
[olist]
 Open the Steam client.
 Log in with the account that owns Space Marine 2.
 Go to your Steam Library.
 Look for “Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Public Test Server” under your Space Marine 2 entry.
 (Optional) Right-click on your Library entry and go to Properties. In the “General” tab, set the game’s default Language to “English”. Translations may still be work-in-progress when you try the new content out on the PTS. As a result, we recommend setting the game to English.
 Once you’ve clicked on this entry, install the Public Test Server content. This install instance is not related to the base game, your files will remain in separate directories and all future updates will also be distinct, meaning that your current progression will not be affected by the time you spend on the PTS.
[/olist]
When the install is complete, the Public Test Server is ready to launch!

Click “Play” like you would with any other game!
‎ 

Can I try every single feature that will be implemented with the next Patch?
Most upcoming content will be available to you. However, we won’t share content that is too buggy or hasn’t undergone the necessary approvals on our side at the time of the PTS release. Also, some content might be present on the PTS, but not accessible to the players. For instance, you may see new Champions in the Armouring Hall but won’t be able to try them unless you own the Season Pass.
‎ 

How long will the PTS be active?

The PTS will run until Patch 8.0 officially launches.

After that, it will go dormant until the next major PTS update.
‎ 

Will my progress be saved?

No, because the PTS runs as a completely separate game version. It does not carry over your previous progress in the game; instead, it provides all players with a default maxed-out level and weapons. This ensures that you won’t have to spend time to unlock all the features, especially the Prestige Ranks.

It will also not save your progress nor transfer it to the official game version afterwards.
‎ 

Is multiplayer available on the PTS?

Yes, even private PvP lobbies will work so you can invite your Brothers and Sisters to play!
‎ 

Do mods work with the PTS?

Mods won't work with the PTS. Enabling them will cause the PTS to crash at launch. Please, make sure to disable them beforehand.
‎ 

How can I give feedback?

We need your feedback!

As mentioned in previous Community Updates, the primary purpose of the Public Test Server is to gather your feedback on new content, changes, and balancing tweaks we plan to implement in the game.

Our main focus will be on PvE Siege Mode and Absolute Difficulty balancing.

We’ve set up dedicated forum threads on Focus Together to let you voice your opinion, which you can find here.

Thank you for helping us make Space Marine 2 the best it can be!

notes.title: May Community Update
notes.content:
Greetings Space Marines,

Let’s review what happened in May, and what’s coming next!
Shall we start off with what everyone’s waiting for?…


SIEGE MODE TEASER TRAILER 🩸

Revealed during the Skulls Festival of Video Games, the Siege Mode will arrive on June 26. This first teaser trailer gives you a first taste of the upcoming battle, watch it if you haven’t already!

Tear through unending waves of Tyranid and Chaos assaults and fight to survive as long as you can.

Give them no ground.

[previewyoutube=NDScTIUHlnc;full][/previewyoutube]
Let’s recap what we know about it already:


 The action takes place on Kadaku.
 Up to 3 players (either with friends or with 2 bots, just like in regular PvE).
 You will get to fight waves of both Tyranids and Chaos.
 Difficulty will increase for each wave defeated.

Your class, and weapon progressions are shared between Operations and Siege Mode
The Siege Mode isn’t a DLC, it’s a free update!

Prepare to hold your ground and survive as long as you can against endless enemies, as only in death does duty end.

​Siege Mode will be playable on the Public Test Server (Steam) starting June 4.
Here’s a tutorial on how to access it.


How it will work ⚙️

You will earn points for each completed wave. Points are distributed among each player (e.g. if the wave grants you 600 points, and there’s three of you: then, each person will get 200 points).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/55c25416184d4c71523316b925500b3312e4bfa0.png
Spend your points at the Requisition Terminals to buy equipment or reinforcements such as Cadians and Marines (Each player can summon 1 AI Space Marine at a time. Choose their class without restrictions!). The strongest and most expensive being the Dreadnought, which joins the battlefield to help you for 3 minutes. Buy equipment and reinforcements to make the fight easier (or less unbearable 😁).

Every 5 waves, you’ll take the elevator to change sectors and therefore field of battle. Completing each Sector will grant your more rewards (requisition points, armoury data, etc.)

And most importantly, your mission is to ​give them no ground.

Are you ready? See you June 26! ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/a6e531e31a5a74b4a50ffd3fef3ebda28f84c081.png

Patch 8.0 - SIEGE UPDATE

You’ll be able to get a first taste of the new content, via the PTS, which will reopen on June 4. Apart from Siege Mode, other features, free and DLC Content are coming with Patch 8.0 in June. 

Here’s a tutorial on how to access the PTS. Contrary to our first PTS: base Game owners can't equip the new customization packs on the PTS, but Season Pass holders can!

Let’s break it down together:

Coming along with the Siege Mode : The White Scars and Blood Angels enter the fray.

FOCUS TOGETHER

🧑‍🎨 Fan Art Contest on Focus Together

You, players, never miss an opportunity to impress us with your art skills. We keep seeing screenshots, painted mini and fan arts everywhere, to our great delight. This time we wanted to host a contest!

We wanted to acknowledge the fact that quality-of-life bugs matter too (such as typos, clipping props of the armour etc…), and we want to fix them. But right now, the major content updates promised in our roadmap are taking up a significant portion of our time. That means some of the smaller fixes will take longer to roll out.

Our current focus is on resolving high-impact issues like crashes and connectivity problems, which can significantly affect gameplay. Every patch aims to bring improvements on that front.

At the top of our priority list right now is improving the connectivity issues that arose after the 7.0 update: We’re mainly talking about infinite “Joining Server” loops and such issues preventing players from joining sessions. We made some improvements with the 7.1 and 7.2 hotfixes, but we’ll keep working on it for the 8.0 update.

Thank you for your patience and understanding as we continue to improve the game. Your support and feedback help guide our work. 🖤

See you on the battlefield, Space Marines.

The Focus and Saber Teams. 🦾

notes.title: April Community Update
notes.content:
Hello Space Marines!

You’re in for a new Community Update, where we’ll discuss what happened throughout April and what’s coming for the next months! Let’s begin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/0a6ea410f462d2a5b6950db04e11ef0cb86b247b.png

RECAP OF THE MONTH

THE TRYGON UPDATE 🐍
In April, we released the 7.0 “Trygon” Update. It contained both free and DLC content, including:


 A new PvE Map called Exfiltration and a new boss fight against the Trygon
 Two cosmetics DLCs: The Imperial Fists Champion Pack and the Space Wolves Chapter Pack
 The inferno Pistol, for both PvE and PvP (available for Assault, Vanguard, Sniper and Heavy)
 Private Lobbies in PvP
 Expanded Weapon Arsenal for all 6 classes
 New elements of customisation, including: Volupus Pink, Thousand Sons Blue, cloth colouring for Bulwark, hand customisation.
 Weapons perks and Prestige Perks were updated
 Several buffs, and bug fixes

Read the details of the patch notes here!

Watch the trailer if you missed it 😉👇

[previewyoutube=7oAHVCnAXxY;full][/previewyoutube]

Nevertheless, the 7.0 Update brought a bunch of unexpected bugs: for instance, matchmaking became a big issue. Saber Interactive deployed the 7.1 hotfix first to improve matchmaking stability. 

Today, we pushed the 7.2 hotfix. It should bring a solution to most connectivity issues, specifically infinite “Joining Server” loops and black screens after completing an Operation.

We’re truly sorry for the inconvenience, we know how much of a bother it’s been for the past weeks.


“SEISMIC ACTIVITY” COMMUNITY EVENT
Your mission has just ended. Were you successful?

This time your brief was to collectively bring down 200,000 Trygons between April 17 and 27.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/e785444e0b43efd977b239ec3397a01a19878e95.png
The least we can say is: you CRUSHED it, Space Marines! It has been tallied that over 800,000 Trygons were obliterated over the course of these ten days.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/8668e574b45f477b1f283220facad92da71a07c7.png

Your faith holds firm, and the enemy lies in ruin. 

As promised, your reward is the Mark X Tacticus Breastplate. Since, the question was raised: yes, you can change the colour of the skulls. 

But that’s not all, to reward your commitment in this event, the ​Porphyr Shield Chainsword skin will be available to claim through PROS. The code will be shared to you on May 5th and until the release of the 8.0 Update. So, stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/d6cc06d71d8d8af11d31de6852581846ce59040b.png

The Emperor provides.



WHAT WE’RE WORKING ON

CODENAME: HORDE MODE
With the Trygon update released, our focus has now shifted to Patch 8, and it is getting closer each day! 🤫

Today we would like to tease you a bit more about what it is going to be like. First of all, you will be able to play up to three players (or with 2 bots, just like in regular PvE) and you will get to fight waves of both Tyranids and Chaos. Difficulty will increase for each wave defeated, so you’ll have to prepare yourself accordingly to vaporize as many waves as you can. Also, your class and weapon levels will be based on your PvE levels.


Oh and here’s a sneak peek of the map! 👀As you can see, the action takes place in Kadaku.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/39ab253e1770992a8f6bfe33a4a793a907474ca8.png
The “Horde Mode” release date and its actual in-game name will be announced at [redacted💀💀]… 


THE NEXT UPDATE
You will have access to the PTS again to test the 8.0 update before the release. Stay tuned, we will give you more information later.

The 8.0 update will bring more free and DLC content to the game. We cannot unveil everything yet, but here’s a few things you can expect from it:

 Blood Angels Cosmetic Pack
 White Scars Champion Pack
 Horde Mode
 Rebalancing of the Absolute difficulty following the community polls

Last month, we did a community poll on Focus Together to collect your feedback and see what you were interested to see on the Absolute difficulty to differentiate it more from Lethal. You will see the changes we made as part of the 8.0 update. Expect an even tougher challenge!

And more, stay tuned 🤫

The release date will also be confirmed during the [redacted💀💀]


FOCUS TOGETHER
Since the release of Space Marine 2, you were encouraged to share your thoughts on the game and even suggest ideas on Focus Together. To this day, we’ve implemented more than 40 ideas from the community, into the game. We always keep an eye on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/f8cb15eecd98ee97151f2335fde8cf5eebba2456.png
Recently, we’ve added the Trygon, the hand customisation, and released the Inferno Pistol.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/0c8ababb11377babf451bd8641abd5dd05a7d22e.png

We also added color customisation to the Bulwark.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/5d3a700fdbf3bb0416a87a2b1df262bd14fce5cc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/c33da9c41e16b3b02e3bf0571ee317837dede092.png

We’ve implemented a Bestiary with lore entries through the Datavault Update and weapons class restrictions have been lifted though the Trygon Update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/60a07d9a8fcec5ed82c4ae30e63d0d96d3361211.png

The lenses colour customisation was made available with the Obelisk update, months ago.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/9873e218eaa1d9d3368181994aa523d042cd5292.png

Private PvP lobbies were implemented as well. And many others! 😊


If your idea has received a lot of upvotes but still hasn’t gotten a response from the devs, it’s likely because it’s still too early for them to give a clear answer. They might be focused on other priorities for now, or they haven’t made a final decision on the matter yet.

We truly appreciate your enthusiasm and patience and we hope you understand that such things take time on our side. ❤️‍🩹

Also, please remember to check if the idea you’re about to drop hasn’t already been entered by another user. Avoiding duplicates makes the job much easier on our side.


THAT’S IT FOR THIS MONTH

As usual, let’s keep in touch on Discord and Focus Together. You can also follow us on our socials: Instagram, X, Facebook, Threads and Bluesky.

See you on the battlefield, Space Marines. 

The Focus and Saber Teams. 🦾

notes.title: Patch Notes 7.0
notes.content:
​Hi Space Marines!

The 7.0 “Trygon update” is now live and brings a lot of changes to Space Marine 2! Before diving into the update, here’s a quick summary of its content:


New Features:

 New PvE Operation: Exfiltration
 Prestige Ranks in PvE
 Private PvP Lobbies
 New Secondary Weapon in PvE and PvP: Inferno Pistol
 New customisation options: 2 new colours, Bulwark cloth colouring, hands colouring


New Season Pass content:

 Space Wolves Chapter Pack
 Imperial Fists Champion Pack


Gameplay & Balancing:

 Extended weapon arsenal in PvE
 Weapon perks updated in PvE
 Improved Matchmaking in PvE and PvP
 Various changes, bugfixes and improvements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/07daefbb4a1d22617d0d1da295c3986fdab0868d.png

— Dmitriy Grigorenko, Game Director

PATCH NOTES

New Features


 New Operation — Exfiltration
Exfiltration takes place on Avarax at the outskirts of an Imperial Hive City ravaged by the Tyranids.. Your mission is to reach a Mechanicus facility, extract a rogue Tech-Priest and fight a Trygon; a giant, burrowing Tyranid that  creates underground passageways for other Tyranid organisms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/2efdd2cf86834005d666c3dd714446afad285c09.png


 Private Lobbies in PvP
A custom lobby to invite your fellow Space Marines. You can choose the mode and map, and also change the gameplay settings, like score or time limit or even damage modifiers to create your own fun game modes.


 Prestige Ranks in PvE
The Prestige system allows you to continue empowering your Class even after reaching the maximum level. Once you have reached level 25, go to the Armouring Hall and follow the activation procedure in the Skill Tree screen. There, you can reset the Class' progress to the first level to unlock one Prestige Perk. After this, you can raise the Class level to 25 again. Thus, a Class can get up to 4 active Prestige Perks simultaneously. Each prestige rank increases XP gain by 10%.

Progressing your Prestige ranks will also grant you unique cosmetic rewards for each rank you unlock.


 PvE Extended List of Available Weapons
Heavy: Heavy Bolt Rifle | Heavy Bolt Pistol
Tactical: Combat Knife | Plasma Pistol | Heavy Bolt Pistol
Assault: Power Sword | Plasma Pistol
Bulwark: Heavy Bolt Pistol
Sniper: Heavy Bolt Pistol | Instigator Bolt Carbine
Vanguard: Heavy Bolt Pistol | Bolt Carbine


Originally the classes were not balanced around having these weapons. Some of those changes are only meant to bring more variety, fun and lore accuracy to the game. Not every change here will make every weapon competitive with the rest of class loadouts.

This isn't the last pass on this, we will continue to monitor the game and make necessary changes. We still have some more ideas how we can expand loadouts more, without breaking the lore and while keeping class identity, but those changes will take a while to implement.


 New Secondary Weapon: Inferno Pistol
Available for Sniper, Heavy, Assault and Vanguard classes.


 Class-based matchmaking in Operations mode
This is a first iteration of the system that is designed to reduce frequency of matchmaking with other people with the same classes. It is not going to prevent this 100%, there will always be some edge cases. We will be tweaking and improving the system on our backend as we go.


 Experimental skill-based matchmaking and team balancing in Eternal War mode
This system should make matchmaking in PvP more fair. This is an experimental feature, we will be turning it on and off on the backend and monitoring the results. It will take a while for it to shape up.


 Public Test Server (PTS)
We are really happy with the PTS experiment that we had. We got a lot of feedback from the community that allowed us to implement changes ahead of actual live release. While having PTS is an additional stress for our team and will cause some delays to live patches we are going to keep doing that for all major content updates moving forward.

The PTS will be closed for now, but we’ll reopen it once we’ll be looking for your feedback on upcoming features.


 New Season Pass Content

Space Wolves Chapter Pack:
- Space Wolves Chapter Champion (Vanguard).
- Space Wolves Chapter Weapon Skins (Bolt Carbine, Thunder Hammer, Chainsword).
- Space Wolves Chapter Customisation (Helmet, Chest, Pauldron, Greave, Heraldry markings).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/a23bd933bf6de3953f589ab4321607a22b467a93.jpg

Imperial Fists Champion Pack:
- Imperial Fists Champion (Tactical).
- Imperial Fists Signature Weapon Skin (Plasma Incinerator).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/33468439454839669c5da543c35d6b18cb3eca9c.jpg


Customisation

New Colours: New default colours Volupus Pink and Thousand Sons Blue.

Bulwark Cloth Recolouring: New feature to recolour the cloth for Bulwark tabard has been added as an option for the chest armour piece for customisation. 

Hands Recolouring: New feature to recolour the gauntlet armour piece is added. Now the primary colour is used to colour a fist and the secondary one colours a wrist and a shoulder part of the hand. (This one is for you, Iron Hands and Crimson Fists fans!)

Lots of minor fixes for customisation of armour parts and emblems.


​Gameplay & Balancing tweaks


Progression Rewards

 Rebalance Rewards in the Eternal War Mode 
Match rewards are increased by 50%.


 Base EXP for PvE is increased
Base XP for all difficulties in Operation Mode is increased by 10%.


PvE Weapon Perks Update

With this update we are rolling out a massive rebalancing and rework of weapon perks. As a result all weapons received buffs one way or another.

Some notes regarding our future plans in terms of balancing: I want to say that I'm not a big fan of changing too many things at the same time. It is hard to predict the outcome, it's a risk of introducing bugs and not every change is a simple number change. Past 2 patches changelogs were several pages long. I'm more in favor of gradual improvements of the game rather than chaotic changes back and forth. This means that we do see your feedback on some of the class perks and weapons etc, even looking at the current weapon perks rework I feel like we could have done a better job with plasma weapons and power sword perks.

There will be a second pass on class, weapon and prestige perks. Probably around Patch 8. I do think that those systems are in much much better shape than they were before patches and on release, the scope of the second pass will be smaller.

"Tyranid Slayer" (Artificer tier): Completely reworked, the new perk is “Strength of Will”:  While performing a Heavy Attack, you take 20% less Ranged Damage.

"Tide of Battle" (Relic tier): Moved to Artificer tier.

“Ground Shake” (Relic tier): Moved to Artificer tier.




 Combat Knife

"Armoured Strength" (Standard tier): Reworked, the new version is: If you have Armour remaining, Melee Damage increases by 10%.

"Chaos Slayer" (Artificer tier): Completely reworked, the new perk is “Combined Onslaught”: Light Combo Attacks with this Weapon deal 10% more Melee Damage.

"Tyranid Slayer" (Artificer tier): Completely reworked, the new perk is “Heavy Onslaught”: Heavy Attacks with this Weapon deal 15% more Melee Damage.

"Tide of Battle" (Relic tier): Moved to Artificer tier.

“Reeling Blow” (Relic tier): Moved to Artificer tier.




 Power Sword

"Armoured Strength" (Standard tier): Reworked, the new version is: If you have Armour remaining, Melee Damage increases by 10%.

"Chaos Slayer" (Artificer tier): Completely reworked, the new perk is “Skilled Restoration”: When your Health is below 30%, a Power Whirl hit restores 1 Armour Segment. Cooldown is 10 seconds.

"Tyranid Slayer" (Artificer tier): Completely reworked, the new perk is “Melee Onslaught”: This Weapon deals 10% more Melee Damage.



Class Perks Update

 Tactical

Radiating Impact: Fixed incorrect bonus stack with Auspex Scan.


 Sniper

Fixed incorrect stacking values of Sniper’s Renewal and Squad Renewal perks. This resulted in following changes:

Squad Renewal: Fixed incorrect ability charge restoring (15% instead of planned 10%).

Renewal: Fixed typo in the description (5% ability charge restored instead of actual 15%).


 Heavy

Enhanced Force: Fixed bonus to melee hold attacks that was mistakenly working in addition to bonus to all melee attacks.


General Balancing


 Assault (PvE only)

Jump Pack Ability: recharge speed increased by 10%.

Contested Heals Restoring by Ground Pound was changed: Ground Pound restores 30% of max contested health, regardless of the type of enemy and their number. When hitting with Ground Pound, 30% of max contested health is restored.

This is a major buff to Assault survivability, because previously its contested health restore depended on too many factors. Now it is significantly increased and will be consistent.


Added a maximum cap to restore fade HP per action; and a max target to restore health per action to the following weapons:
 Multi-Melta
 Melta Rifle
 Heavy Plasma Incinerator
 Plasma Incinerator

This change may sound drastic on paper, but in reality the limit isn't that strict. It only prevents situations where a single shot from Melta could restore the entire health bar when hitting only 3-4 enemies at the same time. Plus, the contested health restore will be more consistent now.



Firearms (PvE only)

We are continuing to polish up weapon balance and I think we are in a good spot right now where all weapons are viable on Absolute difficulty.

Sure, some of them are still worse than others and we will continue to tweak them. Our next big objective is to take a closer look at weapon versions balance within the same archetype. Especially melee weapons.



 Occulus Bolt Carbine 

The Master-Crafted - Alpha (Accuracy) version of the Occulus Bolt Carbine has -15% spread now instead of the +15% spread.


 Multi-Melta

Fixed the bug where the rate-of-fire versions of the Multi-Melta did not have an increased rate of fire. Now, the Master-Crafted version has a 15% increase in RoF, the Artificer version has a 25% increase, and the Relic version has a 35% increase.


 Bolt Rifle (all versions)

Base damage increased by 5%.


 Auto Bolt Rifle

Base damage increased by 5%. Headshot damage increased by 15%.


 Instigator Bolt Carbine

Base damage increased by 5%.


 Bolt Carbine (ONLY Marksman Bolt Carbine versions)

Max ammo increased by one magazine.


 Bolt Pistol

Max ammo increased by two magazines. Base damage increased by 5%. Headshot damage increased by 15%.


 Heavy Bolt Rifle

Reworked versions of the weapon:

Artificer / Salvation of Bakka - Alpha: 
 Magazine Capacity: Increased from 45 to 50
 Ammo Reserve: Increased from 180 to 200

Artificer / Drogos Reclamation - Beta:
 Accuracy: Lowered from 4.5 to 4
 Range: Increased from 6 to 8
 Magazine Capacity: Decreased from 50 to 45
 Ammo Reserve: Lowered from 200 to 180
 Added a scope

Relic / Gathalamor Crusade - Alpha:
 Magazine Capacity: Increased from 45 to 55
 Ammo reserve: Increased from 180 to 220

Relic / Ophelian Liberation - Beta:
 Accuracy: Lowered from 5.5 to 4
 Range: Increased from 6 to 8
 Magazine Capacity: Decreased from 50 to 45
 Ammo Reserve: Lowered from 200 to 180
 Added a scope


In addition to that:
 Max ammo is increased by 1 magazine. 
 Headshot damage increased by 15%.



Other Changes

PvP

- Large amount of small fixes in level geometry collision.


AI

- Carnifex and Helbrute Perfect Parry: Fixed an issue causing Perfect Parry against Carnifex and Helbrute not enabling Gun Strike mark.

- Lots of minor animation fixes for various enemies.


Operations

Inferno:

- Now, if a player reaches the Thunderhawk extraction zone at the final stage of the level, the other players will be forcefully teleported there after some time (they will receive a notification about the teleportation after 1:30 and will be teleported 15 seconds later).

- Large amounts of small fixes in level geometry collision and Terminus enemies getting stuck in some areas.


Obelisk:

- Added a few new voiceovers to make the objectives in the final gameplay sequence clearer.

- Fixed camera clipping on some checkpoints.


General Fixes

- Fixed several issues with Gun Strike misfiring in rare cases.

- Fixed Jump Pack ability changing targets in some rare cases.

- Fixed several issues with Ordeals not counting correctly.

- Fixed a lot of minor issues with perks providing smaller gameplay bonuses than listed in the descriptions.

- Fixed a lot of minor issues with perks not triggering correctly. 

- Fixed a lot of issues with perks not actually providing any benefits to contested health restoring in some cases.

- Lots of minor animation fixes for players.

- Minor UI, sound and VFX fixes and improvements.

- Localisation fixes.



Tech

- Crash fixes and general stability improvements.

- General connectivity improvements.

- Major memory optimisation (Mostly for PvE and PvP).

- Slightly improved performance.

notes.title: March Community Update
notes.content:
Greetings Brothers and Sisters,

Many announcements have taken place throughout March. Let’s rewind a bit, and then let’s dive into the upcoming content! We’ll also tackle the polls taken to make the Absolute Difficulty more to your liking.


MONTH’S REWIND

We’ve made a huge announcement ⭐⭐⭐

Mid-March, we announced that Space Marine 3 had begun development and we’re excited to see your enthusiasm, although we hear those of you who fear for Space Marine 2 and its future support.

So let us set the record straight: Space Marine 3 does not mean the end of Space Marine 2's development. ​Far from it. No teams are shifting over, no one is abandoning the game, and our plans to bring more awesome content to Space Marine 2 remain. We are working on much more content and surprises for the months to come, such as a new class, more operations, melee weapons, and more! Trust us, there are surprises even dataminers haven’t found out about :) 

This announcement simply marks the genesis of a new project, years away from release. We’ve made a decision and have just started the process.

Many of you were very excited for this project and this makes us incredibly happy and motivated. Thank you for the unwavering support.


That being said, we still have a lot to offer to the players with Space Marine 2. 


We launched the PTS on March 13!

The Public Test Server was made available mid-march and you’ve been very dedicated and serious about it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/5ec61352a7be0277f5d94254c2a9496f54626c7b.png

We’ve opened a forum on Focus Together to let you voice your opinion on the content featured in the PTS. Even if we might not have enough time on our hands to reply to every thread, we’re collecting your thoughts and making adjustments on our side. So, thank you!

We already started to compile your feedback, and we’ll implement some of them directly on a PTS update that will come early April. 

Regarding your feedback on the PTS features, we want to tackle the most important one here:



 Prestige Perks are not gamechanger, they are too weak and not worth the effort.

💬 Prestige Perks have not been conceived as game breaking perks meant to allow you to roll on late game content. Another way to say it is that we don’t want the Prestige Perks to be so strong they become “must-haves” for higher difficulties. We really want to emphasize that you don’t need Prestige Perks to beat Absolute difficulty. This would make grinding for them an obligation when we really want them as minor rewards for those who choose to pursue them. The idea behind Prestige Perks is to provide you with more replayability, so you actually have a purpose farming PvE content (other than purging for the Imperium of course!). We don't want players to feel like they need to base their builds upon prestige perks, otherwise it will feel like a forced grind. 

Don’t forget that there’s a unique cosmetic for each class to unlock once you maxed out a class. 


 Prestige Ranks are resetting the class progression to level 1, it will be tedious and too long to get level 25 again.

💬 In recent updates we've increased the amount of xp players are getting in preparation for the prestige system. We've added extermination bonus, quick match bonus, plus new difficulties grant more xp.

On top of that we’ll add an XP bonus to make your post-prestige progression faster.

Again, we are trying to strike the balance between having something to keep playing and not forcing players to grind for a hundred hours.


 The Prestige Perks for the Heavy Class are too centered around melee combat.

💬 We are working on changes regarding the Heavy’s Prestige Perks to better integrate them for Heavy’s builds.


 Assault should have access to the Inferno Pistol!

💬 Absolutely, that’s why we’ll include the weapon to Assault’s options starting from the next PTS update.

Join the players on Discord if you want to chat about this PTS and the future instances!

‎ 
⌛ Patch 7.0 - Trygon Update

Patch 7.0 will be released in mid-April on all platforms. Let’s dissect the content together!

New DLC content

Space Wolves Chapter Pack 🐺

New Map for PvE 🏜️

The new Exfiltration map is coming with Patch 7.0! As the name of the update hints, you will meet with a terrible new boss: the Trygon.

The Trygon is a giant Tyranid creature that can burrow itself in the ground and carve underground tunnels that can be used by smaller Tyranids to bypass the defense lines and coordinate surprise attacks. 

“Exfiltration” takes place on Avarax. Your mission is to exfiltrate a Tech-Priest occupying an Adeptus Mechanicus facility on the planet. However, you’ll have to cross a Trygon territory to reach the facility. You’ll have to deal with the relentless assaults of the creature to complete your mission.

Speaking of PvE, as discussed before in the PTS section, more features will be tweaked. Prestige Ranks will become unlockable, and weapon class restrictions will be adjusted, allowing classes to access more weapons. Additionally, PvE matchmaking will be improved, reducing the chances of joining a team with the same class.

Regarding PvP ⚔️

Patch 7.0 will bring Private Lobbies to PvP! Also, we made matchmaking improvements for better team balancing.

Private Lobbies will give you the opportunity to customise your PvP experience, with many adjustable options! You’ll be able to:

 tag with up to 11 other players (6v6 lobbies)
 toggle friendly fire
 change the class limit restriction
 change the score/time limit
 modify the damage multipliers of the weapons
 … and more!

General additions ➕

 Weapons Perks Rework (details here)
 New Colors available in the Armouring Hall: Volupus Pink and Thousand Sons Blue

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/feb63254040ed3438e8c9d07ed3ceb07bca22e48.jpg

 Cloth coloring for Bulwark and hoods (every class).
 Option to color hands separately from arms
 Also, the Inferno Pistol will now be available to Assault, Vanguard, Sniper and Heavy Class players, both in PvP and PvE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/8a38484141c5c8c7e904c5430a183c351e551b3e.png
​	​	​	​
Cannot wait until the release in April? Try it on the PTS ⚙️

You can try patch 7.0’s WIP content early if you’re playing on Steam! Only thing you need to do is to install the Public Test Server. Here’s a quick tutorial on how to do it. We promise it’s easy!

You can already read the changelog of Patch 7.0 here.

🆙 March Community Event

From March 24 to 30th, XP rewards for both Operations and Eternal war are increased by 25%.
So head back to the battlefield, it’s time to put in the work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/94d84317678899aa9c34c28ef5ebcd81d8e82497.png
You won’t need PROS for this Event.

💡 Ideas on Focus Together

We see your ideas and are doing our best to give them a status and leave comments when we can. However, they remain extremely numerous so please be patient, and remember that we will mainly tackle ideas that have been upvoted with the most G2G points.

🔖 Results of the Absolute Difficulty polls

First of all, we want to kindly thank you for your input! We’re working hard to improve the game and make it to the players’ liking. The Absolute Difficulty, as expressed in the previous Community Update, was tough to balance, so we’re grateful for your inputs. 

Let’s see the results!


 You’ve voted for more enemies on Absolute Difficulty. With a total of 74.64% votes for and 25.36% against.

 You’ve voted against augmenting the Ammo refills limitations. With a total of 24.75%  votes for and 75.25% against.

 You’ve voted for more enemy aggressiveness. With a total of 70.47% votes for and 29.53% against.

 You’ve voted against increasing enemy health and damage. With a total of 15.84%  votes for and 84.15% against.

Your feedback on both the Absolute Difficulty poll and PTS content is well taken. We are planning to make some careful changes in Patch 8.0.

That’s it for this month! As always, we want to thank you for your dedication and your passion! Seeing your feedback and comments on the game really drives us to deliver more and more content. Space Marine 2 wouldn’t be the game it is now without you, and we’re far from finished with this title! 


The Emperor Protects!

The Saber & Focus teams

notes.title: The PTS is coming - Get ready for it with this FAQ!
notes.content:
Hi Space Marines! ⭐ 

The Public Test Server opens March 13! Check out this quick FAQ to help you get started and ready before launch.
‎ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/0a6ea410f462d2a5b6950db04e11ef0cb86b247b.png
‎ 

What’s a Public Test Server?

Space Marine 2’s Public Test Server works as a separate version of the game featuring WIP content and features. Share your feedback to help us refine the patch before its official release. Your input provides an important perspective that will be reviewed by the developer team and have an impact on further game updates.

Since this is a test environment, expect the unfinished content and possible bugs. As you will access it through a different game version, your progression will not be tracked. For each PTS update, you will land on the game with levels maxed out and all weapons unlocked.

Please note that the DLCs won’t be available, regardless of whether you own them.
‎ 
Since the PTS is "Public", you are free to create content based on it. No NDA will be included.

Which platforms can access the PTS?

The PTS is only available on PC via Steam. It is not accessible on consoles (PlayStation/Xbox) or through the Epic Games Store.

Now, let’s see how to install it 👇
‎ 

📝 Tutorial on how to access PTS via Steam:

Just follow these simple steps:
[olist]
 Open the Steam client.
 Log in with the account that owns Space Marine 2.
 Go to your Steam Library.
 Look for “Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Public Test Server” under your Space Marine 2 entry.
 (Optional) Right-click on your Library entry and go to Properties. In the “General” tab, set the game’s default Language to “English”. Translations may still be work-in-progress when you try the new content out on the PTS. As a result, we recommend setting the game to English.
 Once you’ve clicked on this entry, install the Public Test Server content. This install instance is not related to the base game, your files will remain in separate directories and all future updates will also be distinct, meaning that your current progression will not be affected by the time you spend on the PTS.
[/olist]
When the install is complete, the Public Test Server is ready to launch!

Click “Play” like you would with any other game!
‎ 

Can I try every single feature that will be implemented with the next Patch?
Most upcoming content will be available to you. However, we won’t share content that is too buggy or hasn’t undergone the necessary approvals on our side at the time of the PTS release. Also, some content might be present on the PTS, but not accessible to the players. For instance, you may see new Champions in the Armouring Hall but won’t be able to try them.
‎ 

How long will the PTS be active?

The PTS will run until Patch 7.0 officially launches.

After that, it will go dormant until the next major PTS update.
‎ 

Will my progress be saved?

No, because the PTS runs as a completely separate game version. It does not carry over your previous progress in the game; instead, it provides all players with a default maxed-out level and weapons. This ensures that you won’t have to spend time to unlock all the features, especially the Prestige Ranks.

It will also not save your progress nor transfer it to the official game version afterwards.
‎ 

Is multiplayer available on the PTS?

Yes, even private PvP lobbies will work so you can invite your Brothers and Sisters to play!
‎ 

Do mods work with the PTS?

Mods won't work with the PTS. Enabling them will cause the PTS to crash at launch. Please, make sure to disable them beforehand.
‎ 

How can I give feedback?

We need your feedback!

As mentioned in previous Community Updates, the primary purpose of the Public Test Server is to gather your feedback on new content, changes, and balancing tweaks we plan to implement in the game.

Our main focus will be on PvE Prestige Ranks and Weapon Perks. Feedback on these two items will be the most beneficial.

We’ve set up dedicated forum threads on Focus Together to let you voice your opinion, which you can find here.

Thank you for helping us make Space Marine 2 the best it can be!
‎ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/0a6ea410f462d2a5b6950db04e11ef0cb86b247b.png
 ‎ 

What’s included in Patch 7.0 on the PTS?

For this first session, you’ll be able to check the upcoming content of Patch 7.0, which includes:

PvE

 PvE Prestige Ranks
 PvE New Map - Exfiltration (excluding final bossfight). Please note that when reaching the final boss arena, the "Victory" screen starts as soon as you interact with the terminal and the classic mission end behaviour follows (loadings, result screens and return to Battle Barge).
 Weapons Class Restrictions changed (PvE Only: classes now have access to more weapons)
 Improved PvE Matchmaking (reduces the chance of joining a team with the same class)

PvP

 Custom PvP Lobby
 Matchmaking improvements for better team balancing

GENERAL

 Weapons Perks Rework
 New Secondary Weapon - Inferno Pistol (PvE and PvP).
 New Colors available in the Armouring Hall: Volupus Pink + Thousand Sons Blue
 Cloth coloring for Bulwark
 Option to color hands separately from arms

DLC

 “Space Wolves” Chapter Pack: present in-game but not playable.
 "Imperial Fist" Champion Pack: present in-game but not playable.


Thank you for your dedication.
The Emperor Protects.

notes.title: Hotfix 6.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Space Marines,

As announced in the February Community Update, hotfix 6.2 has been deployed on every platform. 
This is a small patch that mostly focuses on crash fixes and minor balancing tweaks in preparation of a major Patch 7 that would focus on weapon perks and weapon loadouts rebalance.

As usual, if you encounter issues with this update, let us know by making a bug report here.

You'll find the complete patch notes down below.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/0a6ea410f462d2a5b6950db04e11ef0cb86b247b.png

PATCH NOTES

General Fixes

 Datavault ordeal Shredding Shrapnel now requires to kill 2 enemies simultaneously with a single frag grenade instead of 3.
 Fixed an issue with the AI Director that could sometimes spawn too many spore mines for a very long period.
 Fixed several issues that would cause Assault class to teleport back after using its Jump Pack ability.
 Minor localization fixes.

Perk PvE Updates

Overall we are quite happy with 6.0 perks rebalance, we are seeing way more build variety for all classes across all difficulties and seeing people experimenting with their builds more. That being said, there are still some perks that will require more attention or even full rework. We will be monitoring the situation and will be making necessary tweaks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/c741d6ad228423769275bff7e195c4362308e0d3.png

Heightened Vigour: 
- Fixed not triggering by perfect Parry or Block in some cases.

Close Targeting: 
- Damage increased from 15% to 25%.

Concentrated Fire: 
- Bonus duration of the Auspex Scan zone increased from 40% to 60%.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/1abf8c6d07944560f7c6535488e606fe81f15ea4.png

Perseverance:
- Damage reduction bonus increased from 15% to 25%.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/49a8b1e1d75b916ba063b4bcda14fc04e773850c.png

Restless Fortitude: 
- Damage reduction bonus increased from 20% to 40%.

Tactical Prowess: 
- Minimum enemy HP for auto finisher increased from 25% to 33%.

Unmatched Zeal: 
- Health regen bonus increased from 20% to 30%.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/b008de073c9e7e17f7c5410a6ebec4145b7304ca.png

Block Break: 
- Damage increased from 25% to 50%.

Evasion: 
- Fixed typo in the description, now it shows correct cooldown of 30 seconds instead of 15 seconds.

Efficient Readiness:
- Fixed typo in the description, now it shows correct 20% movement boost instead of 10%.

Pattern of Excellence: 
- Fixed typo in the description, now it shows correct cooldown of 30 seconds instead of 180 seconds.

Note: This perk was buffed in the 6.0 patch, but localization was not updated and it was missing in patch notes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/6dc73b997ce968ed4d170cec92bf099029c43431.png

Chapter Banner (starting perk): 
- Bonus health increased from 20% to 30%.

Emergency Countermeasure: 
- Cooldown reduced from 120 to 90 seconds.

Defensive Mastery: 
- Cooldown reduced from 120 to 90 seconds.

Glory's Shield:
- Now the perk protects not only from Ranged Damage but from all incoming Damage.

Note: This should improve support Bulwark build a lot, since this perk doesn't impact Banner cooldown

Invigorating Icon: 
- The ability regeneration slowdown has been fixed, but the regeneration penalty is now -50% instead of -100%.

Note: This perk has been discussed a lot in previous patch notes and here are my honest thoughts on this.

We've made a mistake making this perk in the first place. It changes the class behavior too much from what was originally intended. Bulwark is supposed to tank enemies and support his team mates, he isn't a dedicated healer. But players are now used to this playstyle a lot and now absolutely any change to this perk will cause negativity from the community. 

The perk itself is so powerful that it is simply mandatory, plus it also changes how the ability is used. Unlike other classes where abilities are used whenever the player wants, it turns the banner into an ability that the player saves for the very last moment.

In our game it is absolutely fine, if you want to use it that way, but the problem is that with certain other perks you can bring its cooldown to ~20 seconds. This means that not picking this perk will be detrimental to your squad. No matter what the numbers on the neighboring perks, players will always stick to the ability to fully heal when needed.

We want to come back and rework this perk or, rather, perk column in later patches, but this requires some time of experimenting and testing. For now we are tweaking numbers to make a compromise between previous patch and community feedback.

- Dmitriy Grigorenko, Game Director.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/8884de443755dac7bb5665350a070df9cb37914c.png

Fortitude: 
- Health increases from 20% to 30%.

Conversion Field: 
- Radius increased from 10 to 20 meters.


Weapons Balancing

Power Sword
We are very happy with the current melee balance. All melee options are now viable and getting picked by players across all difficulties. However, we see that Power Sword isn't strong enough, compared to much easier to wield Chainsword. It takes more skill to use the Power Sword properly, but the benefit wasn't that great. We want to adjust this a little.

 Overall base damage increased by 5% 
 Power Stance combo damage additionally increased:
 Attack 1 +10%
 Attack 2 +20%
 Attack 3 +30%"

Tech

 Crash fixes and general stability improvements.
 General connectivity improvements.

notes.title: February Community Update
notes.content:
Hello Space Marines 🫡

Let’s recap what occurred in February on Space Marine 2 a bit and then we’ll tackle future topics! We know you're eager for Patch 7 to drop! There's still a bit of a wait, but in the meantime, we'll be sure to tease you a little.

FEBRUARY RECAP

This month we released the 6.0 Datavault Update, containing new free and Season Pass content. You may check the entire changelog here! 📖

Mostly, the biggest features that were added to the game are:

 The Datavault, with new cosmetic rewards
 The Biovore
 New PvP Map “Tomb”
 Salamanders Champion Pack
 Raven Guard Cosmetic Pack including its Successor Chapters
 FOV Slider
 Perks rework

Following that, we released the 6.1 Hotfix to help with a few remaining bugs and connectivity issues, mostly. Again, you can read the patch notes here.
We are aware that with these two updates, a few issues remain, such as: 

 FPS drops
 Too many spore mines spawning at the same time

We’re actively working on it.
Hotfix 6.2 will arrive next week. It shall fix the spore mines issue and bring some balancing tweaks.

IMPERIAL VIGIL COMMUNITY EVENT

We heard about your desire to have an emblem-less Mk VIII Errant Helmet, so here’s your chance! ✨ This cosmetic is entirely free, the only requirement is to link your PROS account to Space Marine 2.
Here’s your brief: “Achieve a victory with each of 6 classes in Operations Mode to win the emblem-less Mark VIII Errant Helmet”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/876731048e75bea664881bc7949c13b396be58a9.png

The event lasts until March 3rd.

NOTE ABOUT COMMUNITY EVENTS

We have noted that the Community Events have received cold feedback since we introduced them as an additional way to unlock cosmetic items. We saw that many of you mentioned FOMO generated by the events. Rest assured, we are not looking to transform Space Marine 2 into a full live service game. The items available through events WILL be available later, for everyone. We want Community Events to be a way to unlock the items in advance, for the most dedicated players, and not to be a source of frustration and stress for everyone.

However, that means we must provide a smooth experience in unlocking said items, which has not been the case so far. We deeply apologize for the trouble, and are currently working on a simplified process to unlock the items, to make the experience less constraining.

WHAT’S COMING…

The 7.0 Update is in the making! ✨ We’re working on it and we’ll give you a more precise date once we get one. 🙌

This update will bring several awaited features:

 One Chapter Pack
 One Champion Pack
 Private PvP lobbies
 A new weapon (only in PvE for now)
 New Operation
 Weapon perks rebalance
 Class weapon loadouts rework
 PvE Prestige Rank: once you reach level 25 on a class, you can buy a Prestige Level that will unlock a unique Prestige Perk. Choose them wisely, because you won’t be able to change your selected Prestige Perks before unlocking the 4 Prestige Levels. On top of that power boost, each class will have a unique cosmetic reward that emphasizes the class’ iconic armour part. 
 and more!

Stay tuned, we’ll soon come with more info.

HORDE MODE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/6f4bd2012c6235fab5e95505ccc44b45a4d0c5db.png

…..So apparently you’re waiting for the Horde Mode.

You’re very eager to get more info on the Horde Mode, it’s one of our top priorities right now. 
One thing we can say is that it will be very different from the Space Marine 1 Horde Mode, and that there are surprises we can’t wait for you to find out about. 😉

Once we get really interesting things to show you about it, we will do it!

Bear with us 🙏

PUBLIC TEST SERVER

We’re also excited to share our goal to launch our Public Test Servers  in just a few weeks! 🙌 Expect it to take place in March and before Patch 7.
Once we get a specific date, we’ll make an official statement on our socials and Discord!

This will give you early access to upcoming features and the opportunity to share your feedback, helping us refine the content before its official release.

It will exclusively happen on Steam, neither on EGS nor consoles. It will be very easy to install because it will act as a separate game.


COMMUNITY FEEDBACK ON THE NEW ABSOLUTE DIFFICULTY - A word from our Game Director

We would like to hear your opinion regarding Absolute difficulty.

Overall, we are quite happy with how intense the difficulty itself is. We see that it requires a lot of concentration and we feel like it’s fun in terms of how many enemies you have to face, how hard they hit you etc. 

At the same time, we see some comments that it’s a bit easy. Yet on the other hand we don’t want to mess it up and would like to hear the voice of the community first.
Here is some data and context.

According to our stats, the average win rate on Absolute difficulty is ~60% (significantly higher than Lethal difficulty that sits at 50%), which seems a bit higher than we expected.
At the same time such high win rate is explained by three facts:
[olist]
 Absolute difficulty is locked for new users
 Only ~12% of daily play time is spent on Absolute difficulty.
 Only ~15% of weekly active players play at least 1 match on Absolute difficulty
[/olist]

This means that only a small portion of very hardcore and well-prepared players are playing the Absolute difficulty, and we must find a proper balance between wishes of the hardcore players and more casual players that simply want to have fun.

I will be completely honest; I think we are almost at our limit in terms of how we can make the game harder without making it unfair and not fun. We can’t significantly increase the number of enemies for performance and memory reasons. Greatly increasing enemy damage and hp will make it so players will die randomly and will make enemies bullet sponges, which will not be fun.

We do not want to implement a new difficulty, because that would split the matchmaking pool even more. We have to stick to the existing 6 difficulties.

The proper way of doing this would be implementing a set of gameplay modifiers (i.e. tight formation gameplay modifiers that we’ve tried to release earlier), combination of which would make each challenge unique. And I’m happy to announce that we are already working on the system, however this will take some time.”

For now, we can tweak some parameters and we would like to hear your opinion on specific items:


❔ Poll 1:
Would you like to see Dual Terminus enemies and more Terminus enemies in general on Absolute difficulty?

We can make it so there will be way more Terminus enemies on a level, potentially 2 at the same time. Plus we can lift restriction that prevents Terminus enemies from spawning on levels that have final bosses (i.e Hive Tyrant)

Vote here

❔ Poll 2:
Shall we slightly increase enemy health and damage on Absolute difficulty?

Some of the builds can break health thresholds and start one-shotting enemies. We are only talking about small health and damage tweaks that should not cause enemies to become bullet sponges.

Vote here

❔ Poll 3:
Would it be better to have more limited ammo refills on Absolute difficulty?

Vote here
 
❔ Poll 4:
Do you want even more aggressive enemies on Absolute difficulty?

Vote here

We will try to implement the adjustments as soon as we can.

- Dmitriy Grigorenko, Game Director.

​Please do not take into account the total number of points spent on an answer. We will only consider the number of entries each answer has received for equity reasons.

EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS ON FOCUS TOGETHER

Twelve new exclusive Space Marine 2 wallpapers have dropped on our community platform Focus Together. Make sure to create an account here and get them for free!
Here’s a sneak peak of some of them:

Once you’ve created your account, you can directly link your Steam account to it. By doing so, you will earn different badges, avatars and titles to pimp your profile, so sign in now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/754f328ed8ab7dcb2a920fded4233f6bd2b39c9a.png

EMOTES WERE WORTH A SHOT!

Since the release of the Datavault Update, you’ve shared countless screenshots showing the different emotes, and we love it!!

Here’s a little compendium but if you want to see more, you should definitely check the wall of screenshots on our Discord! 

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315296/dedee6d1073f6bf364bfbceb55b4862f8322365f.jpg

That’s it for this month!
Don’t hesitate to provide feedback on the upcoming content in the comments below, and in the ideas section of Focus Together.
We’ll see you next month for another Community Update.

With love & respect,
From Saber and Focus.

The Emperor Protects! 🙏
